items.title: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for Network Device Interface (NDI) Sources
items.description: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
items.description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
items.description: Two presenters can share a screen or window at the same time in a Teams meeting. Participants can see both shared content streams simultaneously, making it easier to compare and discuss content from different presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot Search Supports SharePoint Online Custom Properties Search
items.description: Discover and find people through Microsoft 365 Copilot Search based on your company's custom profile properties from SharePoint Online.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. Your profile enables features like voice isolation, speaker recognition, identification in a meeting room and transcripts, and enhanced meeting recaps and insights from Microsoft 365 Copilot. If you don’t yet have a voice profile, just go to the recognition tab in Teams settings and opt-in to enroll your voice from audio during your Teams meetings. Admins can enable or disable this feature.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Discover and act on recommended lead and opportunity actions in Sales agent
items.description:
Sellers can discover and act on lead and opportunity recommendations that are already prioritized for them in Sales agent. A single prioritized list helps sellers see what needs attention without monitoring each agent separately or prioritizing the actions themselves. Sellers can review each recommended action, understand its details and business context, and take action from the same experience.

The initial release focuses on lead outreach actions from Sales qualification agent and opportunity risk actions from Sales opportunity agent. Sellers can discover leads that need outreach and opport

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
items.description: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Add alternate text to images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
items.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
items.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
items.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
items.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
items.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing.  New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

items.title: Power Automate: Direct triggers for desktop flows
items.description: Desktop flows will support direct triggers, enabling automations to start in response to supported events without requiring an intermediary cloud flow. This simplifies automation design and reduces the effort required to connect desktop flows to business processes.

items.title: Power Automate: Credentials - Integration with Delinea secret server
items.description: Power Automate will support Delinea Secret Server as an external credential provider for desktop flows. Organizations can securely use credentials managed in Delinea for machine sign-in and credential retrieval during attended and unattended automation.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat Sheet UX Update for Mobile
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Top sites in Edge search bar
items.description: Adding easy access to top sites in Edge search bar on desktop. Users can add, edit, remove, or hide top sites. Admins can control available to this feature using the NewTabPageManagedQuickLinks and NewTabPageQuickLinksEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Practice presentations with Speaker Coach in Learning Activities
items.description:
In learning activities, students can rehearse presentations, receive feedback on their delivery, and practice again with targeted suggestions to improve clarity and confidence.

#education

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Microsoft Learning Zone - Minecraft connected lessons
items.description:
Bring Minecraft Education to every classroom with AI-powered tools that match curriculum goals to Build Challenges, blend lessons with project-based learning, launch directly from Learning Zone, and give you full visibility into participation, completion, and student understanding.

#education

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration
items.description: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration for User Data Migration (UDM) and Shared Data Migration (SDM) allows customers to move their Microsoft 365 data from one Microsoft tenant to another. UDM includes the ability to move user mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, Teams chats, and Teams meetings. SDM includes the ability to move M365 Groups, SharePoint Sites, Group Mailboxes, and teams and channels.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
items.description: Microsoft Edge for Business is expanding its existing Data Loss Prevention Enterprise Connector capabilities. Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows. Additional controls include required bypass justification and administrator-defined guidance.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Tenant policy controls who can record and transcribe
items.description: Teams administrators can use meeting policies to control who can start recording and transcription, helping organizations apply consistent meeting settings. Administrators can restrict these permissions to organizers and co-organizers or extend them to presenters. They can also determine whether meeting organizers can modify these settings or whether they are enforced by policy.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Real-time queue metrics in the Queues app on Mobile
items.description: Calling representative and Supervisor leads can view real-time call queue metrics directly from the Queues app on Mobile, giving them greater visibility into current queue activity and performance while on the go. Users can quickly understand the state of their queues, monitor key operational metrics, and make more informed decisions about their availability and queue participation without needing to switch to desktop.

items.title: Outlook: More visibility into usage for recoverable items storage
items.description: You'll be able to see how much storage your recoverable items are using in Outlook. This gives you a clearer picture of your storage usage before you reach a limit. You can use this information to make more informed decisions about managing your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Expand or collapse all accounts at once
items.description: You'll be able to expand or collapse all accounts at once in Outlook's folder pane. You won't need to expand or collapse each account individually. This makes it easier to navigate multiple accounts or keep your folder pane compact. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Remember your online archive folder pane state
items.description: Outlook will remember whether your online archive is expanded or collapsed when you return. Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows will each keep their own saved state. This saves you from repeatedly expanding or collapsing your archive as you navigate your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Keep folders expanded when you restart Outlook
items.description: Outlook will remember which folders and shared mailboxes you have expanded or collapsed when you restart the app. You can pick up where you left off without opening the same folder branches again. This makes returning to your usual folders easier. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Sort your subfolders from A to Z
items.description: You'll be able to sort a folder's subfolders alphabetically from the parent folder. This makes it easier to find the folder you need without rearranging subfolders one by one. It's a simple way to keep long folder lists organized. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Keep folder sharing within your organization's policies
items.description: Folder sharing in Outlook will respect your organization's restrictions for Default and Anonymous permissions. When these restrictions are enabled, you won't be able to change either setting. Permissions granted directly to individual users will remain unaffected. This helps keep folder sharing aligned with your organization's policies. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Secure Dataverse record with column-based filtering
items.description: This enhancement introduces column-based security filtering, enabling records to be secured using attribute values rather than traditional ownership. This allows security admins to define access based on business dimensions such as region or department, making it ideal for scenarios where record ownership does not exist—such as reporting and aggregated datasets. By eliminating the need for artificial ownership or complex sharing models, this approach simplifies security administration, improves scalability, and aligns Dataverse access control more closely with enterprise data governance practi
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork: Access Business Applications with Work IQ
items.description: Users can access Business Applications through Work IQ in Copilot Cowork and use Business Skills to complete end-to-end business processes grounded in their enterprise data and apps. This helps users move from finding the right business application to taking action across key workflows with less context switching.

items.title: Work IQ: Business Skills to manage your business processes in Work IQ MCP
items.description:
Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done. They represent your business processes, policies, and domain knowledge in a format that agents can understand and follow. Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply.

Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to your organization's processes. When multiple agents use the same skill, they follow the same process

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control
items.description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
items.description:
We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.

For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
items.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking
items.description: Viva Glint survey takers will be able to use a streamlined version of Microsoft Copilot in the Glint survey taking experience to help them rewrite their comments, helping survey takers feel more confident about the feedback they’re providing. By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments, which can drive higher engagement and richer insights from surveys.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Windows acts as an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group.  You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebooks available in OneNote on Web
items.description: Users will now have access to their Copilot Notebooks on the web version of OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents
items.description: Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Add Search results as references to your Copilot Notebooks in the M365 Copilot app
items.description: Users can quickly add a Search result as a reference to a Copilot Notebook within the M365 Copilot app.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. Updated April 16: We are still in development for GA and have launched to Preview only.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent recap for DoD
items.description: Intelligent meeting recap uses AI to provide a quick summary of your meeting, highlighting key discussion points, identifying follow-up actions, and offering quick access to significant points such as name mentions, when a screen was shared, individualized speaker markers, topics, and chapters.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention – Restrict access action support for sematic models and lakehouses in Fabric
items.description: Your organization can now control who can access your data depending on the sensitive information detected in Fabric semantic models and lakehouses. DLP restrict access action allows you to block access to guest users or all users depending on what labels or sensitive information types matches your semantic models or lakehouses. This is in addition to the ability already supported by DLP policies to audit and notify users via Policy Tips based on sensitive content within Fabric semantic models and lakehouses.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Updated March 20, 2026: We have paused release of this feature temporarily and will announce new release timelines soon. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
items.description: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description:
We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation.

The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helpin

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
items.description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher agent and Microsoft 365 Chat, allowing users to bring data into their workflows.

items.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
items.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
items.description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation snapshot but were processed during enforcement.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Additional health signals available for Teams Rooms on Android on Pro Management Portal
items.description: Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network. When issues are detected, PMP will automatically generate actionable alerts and support ticket creation workflows, enabling IT administrators to proactively identify and triage room health issues before they impact meeting experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
items.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
items.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

items.title: Outlook: Block External Images Settings Update
items.description: Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows now support will support new settings for loading external images. New settings will allow customers to block all external content, or to load all content by default if the customer admin allows. Existing default behavior will not be changed (load external content only for safe senders).

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI-powered visibility into DLP policy deployment across devices, helping admins track sync progress and understand enforcement coverage. They proactively identify impacted devices, explain root causes of sync failures, and guide admins with recommended actions to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds
items.description: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent capabilities for organizations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
items.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

items.title: Power Apps: New view layout in model-driven apps
items.description:
Makers can now choose to display their data as a calendar or a stack of cards instead of the default grid layout. Makers can configure these layouts directly in the model driven app designer, giving users more intuitive ways to visualize and work with their data.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Export Improvements
items.description: New export improvements are coming to Cloud Update, making it easier for organizations to access and analyze device data. These enhancements will expand export capabilities across Inventory and Cloud Update device views, include additional device and update information, and allow admins to export filtered results so they can focus on the devices most relevant to their needs.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description:
Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.

Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-View-only access to device onboarding with the View-Only Device Management role
items.description:
Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing more granular, role-based access to the Devices page under Settings → Device Onboarding. Previously, viewing or managing device onboarding required broad administrative roles (such as Compliance Administrator, Global Administrator, or Security Administrator). With this update, organizations can grant access using least-privilege Purview role-based access control (RBAC) roles scoped specifically to device operations.

A new View-Only Device Management role enables users, such as auditors or security analysts, to view device onboarding status

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
items.description: For non-channel Microsoft Teams meetings, collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive for Business instead of the OneDrive of the person who starts the notes. This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.157 - Updated performance information in tab hover cards
items.description: Microsoft Edge is updating tab hover cards to provide clearer information about tab memory usage and memory savings when inactive tabs are discarded. Users will also have separate settings for tab-preview images and memory-usage information.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: Work IQ: Execute (Recipes)
items.description: Enable agents to execute reusable Work IQ recipes that coordinate supported tools and actions.

items.title: Work IQ: Federated connectors
items.description: Enable Work IQ to use federated connectors for governed access to additional enterprise data sources.

items.title:
Microsoft Teams: Multiple screen shares
in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: You can now view up to two shared screens side by side during meetings, reducing interruptions from screen hand-offs. Participants can switch between side-by-side and expanded views, identify presenters for each screen, and benefit from layouts optimized for single or dual displays. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Frontier expands to public previews in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint
items.description: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. Frontier enrollment is optional and separate from Standard and Deferred release preferences for generally available features. Existing Frontier users do not need to re-enroll.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
items.description:
Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases. Rather than assigning from a fixed pool or waiting for overflow rules to trigger, this approach progressively widens availability in concentric rings—starting with the best-fit representatives and expanding outward as needed.

Administrators configure this scenario by associating user groups with a queue and defining wait time thresholds for each tier. For example:

- 0–30 seconds: Assign to Tier 1 specialists (primary user

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
items.description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered into an interactive experience.

items.title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
items.description: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use overflow actions to protect customer experience for direct inward calls
items.description:
Overflow for direct inward dialing leverages conversation orchestration to detect key direct inward dialing-related events—such as the representative being busy, offline, rejecting the call, or failing to answer—and apply administrator-defined fallback actions.

Administrators configure natural language playbooks using conversation orchestration at the global or inbound profile level to specify the action to run when a direct inward dialed call can't be attended to or completed. The actions include offering a direct callback to the caller, sending them to voicemail, transferring the call to an

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks
items.description: Conversation orchestration in Dynamics 365 Contact Center keeps every conversation actively managed throughout its lifecycle, from initiation through resolution. Instead of applying fixed rules at different stages of a conversation journey, conversation orchestration monitors each conversation as conditions evolve, like wait time increases, fast-filling queues, or service representatives going offline, and responds automatically with the right action. For example, administrators can define the intent using natural-language playbooks as follows: "If a premium customer waits for more than three

items.title: Power Pages: SDK (Software Development Kit)
items.description: Build native mobile applications or kiosks using Power Pages as the backend foundation with support for authentication, authorization, APIs, data access, and reusable mobile capabilities.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Handle waiting conversations when queues close or become unstaffed
items.description:
This capability enhances queue handling by intelligently detecting two key scenarios where conversations would otherwise remain unserved:

- Queue transitions to out-of-operating hours: The system continuously monitors active conversations that entered a queue before closing time. If the queue transitions to out-of-operating hours while conversations are still waiting, it automatically applies admin-defined overflow actions. Customers can be guided to leave a voicemail, request a callback, or be transferred to another available queue, ensuring a smooth end-of-day experience without manual inte

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Assign conversation to expert who engaged with the customer previously
items.description: Assign to a previously engaged or preferred expert leverages historical interaction context, queue membership alignment, and expert availability, to ensure customers are reconnected with experts who already understand their issue. When the previous or preferred expert is unavailable, assignments seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified expert, preserving service levels and reliability. This capability reduces repeat explanations, accelerates resolution times, and improves customer satisfaction, helping businesses lower cost to serve while delivering more consistent, personalized support

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
items.description: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

items.title: OneDrive: Prompt gallery for Copilot
items.description:
Discover easier ways to use Copilot in OneDrive

The new Prompt Gallery offers ready-to-use prompts for common file tasks, helping you get started quickly, discover what Copilot can do, and customize prompts to fit your needs.

Access the Prompt Gallery from:

The Copilot button in the bottom-right corner of OneDrive

The + button in the Copilot chat pane

Select Open Prompt Gallery to explore prompts across categories such as Create, Analyze, Find, and Collaborate.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
items.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

items.title: Planner: Local Custom Fields/Columns
items.description: Custom Fields let you tailor your plans to match the way your team works. Add Text, Number, Date, Yes/No, and Choice fields to capture the information that matters most. View and update custom fields across Board, Grid, and Task details, with support for sorting, filtering, grouping, and bulk editing to keep your work organized and easy to manage.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
items.description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats
items.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center
items.description: Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Outlook: Enriching profile cards with custom, organization-specific properties
items.description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding custom properties unique to their organization. These properties can be sourced from external systems like HR platforms, enriching user profiles with relevant organizational details. Tenant admins can configure these properties with a display name and icon, which will appear in the Contact Information section of the profile cards.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Streamlined Authentication process with OAuth for Connector Admins
items.description: Effortless authentication, unified through OAuth — empowering Connector Admins to connect in just a few clicks. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Improve discovery of Champion connector prompts for Users
items.description: Improve discovery of Champion connector prompts - inline suggestive pre & post prompts, prompt library.

items.title: SharePoint: New Microsoft 365 Copilot Skills for SharePoint Administration
items.description:
We’re excited to announce two new Copilot skills in the SharePoint Admin Center:

- Step-by-Step Task Guidance

Copilot can now walk you through the exact steps required to complete common admin tasks.

Example: “How can I find sites that are potentially over-permissioned?”

What to expect: Copilot will recommend clear, sequential instructions to guide you from start to finish.

- Multi-Criteria Site Search

Copilot can help you find sites using multiple conditions at once.

Example: “Find sites that have been inactive for more than 60 days and are shared externally.”

What to expect: Copilot

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
items.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate.  We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Import HRIS data in Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center
items.description: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

items.title: OneDrive: Command-line tool for the OneDrive sync app
items.description: A new command-line tool, odcli, lets OneDrive users, IT admins and support engineers check and manage the OneDrive sync app from the command line. Commands cover sync status, accounts, configuration, policies, and managing the sync app. JSON output lets scripts, management tools and AI agents automate these tasks.

items.title: Work IQ: Memory capabilities expand to agents
items.description: A new Work IQ MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, gives authorized agents access to a user’s memory profile. This profile enables agents to provide more personalized and relevant assistance. At launch, it includes Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, relevant work account data, and memories derived from chat history. The memory profile will continue to evolve and improve over time.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC and GCC High
items.description:
We are expanding the availability of Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics capabilities in Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC, or GCC-M) and GCC High (GCC-H). Availability differs for a small number of capabilities by cloud, as noted below.

•	Eligible users will see updated Insights app features and supported Insights Admin Center experiences.

•	Adoption and Impact experiences will include supported Copilot usage and impact measures, group and app views, trends, and filters.

•	Analysts will gain access to additional Advanced Analysis reports and queries. Supported users will also h

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Microsoft 365): Accounting skills
items.description:
Streamline corporate accounting work

New accounting capabilities in Excel and Cowork help accountants spend less time on repetitive, manual tasks in the places they already work, including:

•	Reconcile accounts with confidence: Compare balances and transactions, identify discrepancies, and prepare reconciling items for review.

•	Prepare journal entries faster: Draft accruals, reclassifications, allocations, reversals, and recurring entries, with checks for required inputs and balanced entries.

•	Turn results into clear reporting: Analyze financial performance against plan, identify key dri

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Microsoft Learning Zone - Improve Lesson Insights
items.description:
See where your class is struggling and which students need support, with lesson-level results for every student. Aggregated responses show the mistakes many students made in a lesson. You can then open each student's answers to plan targeted follow-up.

#education

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Enable version trimming for data covered by retention policies in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Let tenants trim file-version bloat created by retention, without breaking compliance promises. SharePoint/compliance admins at large, regulated enterprises must cap and reclaim storage consumed by retained file versions, while keeping legal-hold and records promises intact. Admins with appropriate Purview RBAC can enable version cleanup for ODB/SPO content even when retention policies are in effect. This would be a policy scoped setting that essentially overrides the default behavior where all versions are retained. When turned on, SharePoint’s version management will be permitted to trim fil

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
items.description:
Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit.

#education

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
items.description: Get a closer look at shared content in Teams calls and meetings with pinch-to-zoom using your touchpad. Quickly zoom in to make small text and detailed visuals easier to see, then zoom back out for the full view. Existing zoom controls remain available.

items.title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
items.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Data Quality Report for Profile Data
items.description: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services is introducing a new data quality report that helps administrators assess the coverage and health of people data used across Microsoft 365 experiences. High-quality people data enables users to more effectively discover and learn about colleagues through experiences such as the People Card, Org Explorer, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Cowork. The new report provides organizational data administrators, People Administrators, and AI Administrators with visibility into the completeness and quality of people attributes available in Microsoft 365

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
items.description: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs getting deprecated by OCT 2026.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows
items.description: Integrate proprietary systems, dynamic knowledge sources, and custom actions into your agentic workflows with MCP support, accelerating extensibility while preserving workflow reliability. This integration improves reuse across agents and workflows, reduces duplication of integrations, and embraces an emerging open and extensible agent ecosystem.

items.title: SharePoint: Admin Center - Data Access Governance - Permission report for a given group
items.description: A single group with broad membership or a special group for vendors etc. - can expose sensitive content to unintended recipients. With this new report, SharePoint admins can now see every site a group can access and the extent of that access.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
items.description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. Muted chats (on by default) are grouped together in a dedicated area, while meeting chats (off by default) can be collected into a single section for quick access. You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences. The new Meeting chats section will replace the Meeting chats filter, that was previously available at the top of the chat and channel list. Updated July 20, 2026: We have temporarily rolled back this fea

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Email messages
items.description: Organizational Messages now includes Email as a delivery channel, expanding beyond existing surfaces such as the Windows Taskbar, Windows Notifications, Windows Spotlight, and Teams Popovers.

items.title: Outlook: Share Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
items.description: When working in an open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, users will now be able to send a copy of the locally stored file by email through the new Outlook for Windows.  #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
items.description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot experiences to drive greater value across their organization. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Outlook: Insert signature into calendar events
items.description: Users can manually insert a signature into a calendar event like they can in the classic outlook. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling for legacy Office files
items.description: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt). Organizations can automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Expiration for access on sharing main links
items.description: People can set expiration dates for “Anyone” and “People in your organization” access on the main link to files and folders in OneDrive and SharePoint. New administrator policies can Administrators can set policies to require expiration and enforce a maximum access duration, with separate settings for OneDrive and SharePoint. These controls help organizations align content sharing with their data governance requirements. When access expires, the main link remains, and permissions granted directly to individuals are preserved.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
items.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
items.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels
items.description: Teams now lets you set and manage reminders directly on chat and channel messages, helping you keep track of important items. Create, update, complete, and delete reminders, track them in a dedicated Reminders view, and receive timely notifications when they become due. Reminders are private to each user and include message context, making them easy to revisit and act on when needed.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
items.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage - Improved shared messages end-user experience
items.description: Improving the shared conversation experience in Viva Engage to so it's easier for users to discover, read, and participate.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
items.description: Agents and supervisors can use Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile to quickly understand and follow up on customer conversations. From shared call history, users can ask questions about a past call and use Copilot to surface relevant information and insights from the conversation, helping them get up to speed and take the next step without having to review the entire call

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Shared call history in the Queues app on Mobile
items.description: Calling reps and Supervisor leads can view shared call history for their call queues in the Queues app on Mobile, helping them track call activity, review call details, and coordinate customer follow-ups while on the go.

items.title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance using Microsoft 365 files in model-driven apps
items.description:
We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use Microsoft 365 files as a source, helping users turn existing content into form entries with less manual effort.

Availability

Field
Value

Monthly

2701.1

Model-driven apps
