Admins or makers | Users (enabled by admins or makers) | Users (enabled by default) | Users (always enabled)

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Turn meeting discussions into PowerPoint presentations with Facilitator
items.description: When it's time to present what your team decided, you can ask Facilitator to create a PowerPoint presentation from what was said, chats, and shared files in the meeting. It turns the conversation into the slides, whether that's a project update, a proposal, or a readout for leadership. Facilitator can already draft documents in Word, so now your team can also go straight from discussion to a deck.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
items.description: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

items.title: Planner: Private tasks now stored in your private plan
items.description: Private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences are stored in the user’s private plan, providing a single place for tasks visible only to that user. Private tasks cannot be shared or assigned to others, and existing tasks continue to work and appear alongside them.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
items.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams events attendance and engagement report policy
items.description: Teams events will soon have a separate attendance and engagement report policy from the "CsTeamsMeetingPolicy" attendance and engagement report policy. This will permit admins to allow Teams events organizers to access attendance and engagement reports, while restricting access to Teams meeting attendance and engagement reports.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
items.description: Call delegation in Teams now includes new controls that give delegators greater privacy and control during active calls. Delegators can lock an ongoing call to prevent delegates from joining or resuming the call and can optionally enable warning tones that notify participants when a delegate joins or resumes a call.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Language selection by users in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Users can now choose their preferred meeting language in Teams Rooms on Android. Select from up to 69 languages using the language button on the console. The room system must restart after a language is selected.

items.title: Planner: My Tasks redesign
items.description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Assign Open Shifts
items.description: Auto Assign Open Shifts is a Microsoft Teams Shifts feature that automatically fills unassigned (open) shifts for you. It lets managers automatically assign open shifts to available employees instead of doing it manually. The system considers factors like employee availability, approved time off, past scheduling patterns, and scheduling rules (e.g., max hours, rest time); and generates a draft schedule that you can review and adjust before publishing.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
items.description:
We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint.

Generate document from form (Preview) allows customers to create documents from a template by mapping data inputs to predefined template fields.

Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint.

This capability supports scenarios such as creating contracts, invoices, letters, or reports using structured templates and form-driven inputs.

The action works by mapping input data to template fields and returns the generate

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
items.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Building level insights on the Pro Management portal recommended actions page
items.description: IT gets new building level insights on the recommended actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.  This feature intelligently identifies buildings with high Teams Rooms utilization to help IT prioritize upgrades of bring your own device (BYOD) meeting spaces and ensure consistent, high-quality user experiences throughout their office buildings.  Available with a Teams Rooms Pro or Shared Space license.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Insider risk management for agents
items.description:
As AI agents become deeply embedded in enterprise ecosystems, they are evolving beyond simple tools or workflows into a digital workforce. These agents can interpret intent, access and manipulate enterprise data, execute actions and even make real-time decisions. In many ways, they operate like human insiders only with machine-speed data processing capabilities.

To govern and protect these agents effectively, Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is being expanded to agents, with specific indicators and insider risk score built for agents based on agentic activities.

Microsoft Purview In

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for refining query filters for Confluence Copilot connectors
items.description:
This feature enhances and standardizes query filtering across both Confluence Cloud and Confluence On-premises connectors.

For Confluence Cloud connector, it introduces simplified options to filter pages by page id, creation date/time and last update date/time, helping improve productivity and reduce human errors.

For Confluence On-premises connector, it adds support for advanced CQL-based filtering, enabling more complex and flexible filtering scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recap for call queue calls on Mobile
items.description: Calling reps and supervisor leads can access intelligent call recap for call queue calls directly from the Queues app on Mobile. After a call, users can quickly catch up on the conversation with AI-generated notes, key discussion points, and recommended follow-up tasks, helping reduce the time spent reviewing calls and making it easier to move customer conversations forward while on the go.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on Mobile
items.description: For call queue calls that are automatically recorded by the organization, Teams on Mobile will clearly indicate that recording and transcription have started automatically and cannot be stopped. This gives users clearer and more accurate information about the recording state of their call and provides a consistent experience across desktop and mobile.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Manage call groups on Mobile
items.description: Users can create and manage their call group directly from Teams on Mobile. They can add or remove members, configure how the group should ring, and choose to forward or simultaneously ring incoming calls to their call group. This makes it easier for users to manage how their calls are handled without needing to switch to the desktop experience.

items.title: OneDrive: Respond to access requests directly in the Share dialog
items.description: Review and respond to access requests inside the Share dialog. When people request access to a file, folder, or library, anyone who can share it will see pending requests right in the Share dialog for that item. From there, they can choose the level of access to grant, approve or decline requests individually or in bulk, and message the requester before deciding. Requests for more access, such as edit rights for someone who can already view, appear alongside new requests, making it faster to grant the right access and keep work moving.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Connectors, and Agents for US Government customers
items.description:
We are introducing new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Copilot Connectors, and Copilot Agents for US Government customers across GCC Moderate, GCC High, and DoD environments.

These reports will provide administrators with organization-level and user-level insights to help them understand usage and adoption of these Copilot capabilities.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Activity in other accounts and orgs improvements
items.description: Stay up-to-date with what's happening in your other accounts and organizations with the 'Activity in Other Accounts and Orgs' panel. Preview and open chats, channels, and other activity in other accounts and orgs from your main Teams window, without switching tenants.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Default meeting templates
items.description: Default meeting templates enable IT admins to automatically apply their organization’s preferred meeting settings whenever users schedule a Teams meeting through Outlook or Teams calendar. This helps organizations apply meeting settings (including protection settings) at scale, and reduce the need for organizers to manually configure meeting options. Only organizers with a Teams Premium (T-Pre) license assigned can use Default Meeting Templates.

items.title: Microsoft Purview:  Permissions audit log improvements
items.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Customize blocked file extensions for Weaponizable File Protection
items.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding admin controls for Weaponizable File Protection. Administrators will be able to customize which file types are blocked in Teams to align with their organization's security requirements or continue using the Microsoft-recommended default list. This added flexibility helps organizations tailor file protection policies while maintaining a secure collaboration environment.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
items.description: Multi-line users get a redesigned call history experience that organizes activity by phone line. Call activity is organized into dedicated tabs for each line, so history, voicemails, and recordings appear under the line they belong to, making navigation and call management simpler and more intuitive.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Upgraded call history in Teams Calls app
items.description: Call history in the Teams Calls app is being upgraded to make it easier to find and act on past call activity. Missed calls and associated voicemails will be consolidated into a single call history entry, reducing clutter and simplifying follow-up. Call history will also expand from 100 records to up to 3,000 records or 6 months of history, whichever limit is reached first, giving users more context when they need it.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
items.description: Configure retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to help preserve historical versions of memory items for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios. Copilot memory includes saved memories and details inferred from chat history that enable more personalized and context-aware Copilot experiences. Copilot memory items are stored in a hidden folder in the user’s Exchange mailbox. This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items so that administrators can maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by the Copi

items.title: Microsoft Teams: App centric management in Teams Admin Center to manage the Apps access for tenants, end-users, and groups in DoD
items.description: App centric management introduces new admin settings to control who in the tenant can install Teams apps. First, admins can set a default value for new apps that are published to Teams app store. Second, admins can edit the availability of an app to “All users can install,” “Specific users and groups can install,” or “No user can install.” This feature evolves the existing app permission policies and provides admins with the ability to manage access to the app individually. The app permission policies for existing customers are migrated to maintain existing app availability in the tenant.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: App centric management in Teams Admin Center to manage the Apps access for tenants, end-users, and groups in GCC High
items.description: App centric management introduces new admin settings to control who in the tenant can install Teams apps. First, admins can set a default value for new apps that are published to Teams app store. Second, admins can edit the availability of an app to “All users can install,” “Specific users and groups can install,” or “No user can install.” This feature evolves the existing app permission policies and provides admins with the ability to manage access to the app individually. The app permission policies for existing customers are migrated to maintain existing app availability in the tenant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security for non-Microsoft connected apps
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection Auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps (e.g., Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Amazon Web Services, and Cisco Webex). The conditions and actions supported for each of these applications vary.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint app in Teams
items.description: When a user who has access to the SharePoint app in Teams clicks a SharePoint page or news link in Teams chat or channels, the link will open inside the SharePoint app in Teams (if available) instead of the mobile browser

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

items.title: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
items.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
items.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection with Microsoft Purview and Palo Alto Prisma Access
items.description: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Palo Alto Prisma Access, extending discovery and protection to network traffic. With this integration, new and existing Palo Alto Prisma Access customers can configure Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention policies to discover and protect sensitive data shared with unmanaged cloud apps via HTTP/HTTPS, using the same classifiers, sensitive information types, and sensitivity labels used in other Purview policies. This integration further enriches Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Risk Management (I

items.title: Microsoft Viva: New Post Creation Experience in Viva Enage
items.description: In Viva Engage, we've simplified how to create posts. The new post creation experience makes it easier and faster to share in Viva Engage with a cleaner, more intuitive publishing experience. It brings clearer layout, better accessibility, and smarter organization of tools—so you can focus on creating great posts without extra clicks or clutter.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

items.title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for leader communications
items.description: We’re introducing more flexible and precise targeting capabilities in Viva Engage, starting with Storyline Announcements. This new feature allows leaders and their delegates to define a custom audience at the time of posting, without relying on pre-configured Leader Audiences. Audiences can be built, and saved for reuse, using organizational attributes such as department, job title, or country, existing groups like M365 Groups, distribution lists, or security groups, and even individual users by name. This flexibility enables more relevant communication, helping leaders reach the right people

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Select Password from the context menu
items.description: Users can now manually access saved credentials when password suggestions don't appear automatically. When a user right-clicks a recognized username or password field, a new Select Password option appears in the context menu. This provides a reliable fallback path for sign-in scenarios where autofill suggestions are not surfaced, reducing the need for users to copy credentials manually. No configuration is required, and existing password management policies continue to apply.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
items.description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD
items.description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. Admins can view each connector's read and write/delete tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center and disable co

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
items.description: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
items.description: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.156 - Improvements to site permissions user interfaces
items.description: To better align with user expectations, site permissions are changing to look and work both in context on a website that is requesting permissions and when navigating to permissions from Settings. On a website that is requesting permissions, there are changes to the Omnibox and the Page Info dialog and permissions will be easier to see and modify in Settings.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.156 - Enhanced Autofill
items.description: For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements
items.description: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors; support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business
items.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open browser tabs and YouTube videos directly from the Edge side pane

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
items.description:
We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center.

With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the first planned scopes, with broader user and group policy support planned for a later phase.

Further
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Network analytics enhancements
items.description:
Network analytics updates are rolling out in Microsoft Viva Engage, giving corporate communicators and network admins more flexibility to analyze activity and engagement across their organization.

With this update, network analytics includes custom date ranges, faster activity data refreshes, updated dashboard and metric table designs, expanded organizational filters with search, and new people-manager filters for viewing direct reports or full reporting hierarchies. These enhancements make it easier to explore trends, understand audience engagement, and measure communications impact across t

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Decline a call with a message on Mobile
items.description: Users can quickly decline an incoming Teams call and send a predefined message to the caller at the same time. From the incoming call screen, users can select a message such as letting the caller know they're unavailable or will call back, providing helpful context without having to answer the call or separately open a chat.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
items.description: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

items.title: Outlook: All Day events to show up more clearly in the Mail module Calendar Preview
items.description: We're making it easier to tell when receiving meeting invites that conflict with scheduled Out of Office time or Busy All Day events, on Outlook Web and Outlook for Windows.

items.title: Outlook: Sort improvements to the message list
items.description: When sorting on Outlook for Web or Outlook for Windows, if the Sort By field is not one of From, Subject, or Date Received, we will now show an additional column for the Sort By value (e.g., Size). We will also support sorting by Flag Due Date.

items.title: Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
items.description: Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines.

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes.   Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place.  Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes.   The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account.   Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
items.description: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.

items.title: OneDrive: Updated placement of the Create or upload button for Web
items.description:
OneDrive for the web is updating the placement of the Create or upload button to provide a more consistent file experience across OneDrive and SharePoint. The button will move from the left navigation pane to the right side of the page, bringing familiar navigation from SharePoint document libraries to OneDrive.

The available options for creating files and folders or uploading content will remain unchanged.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
items.description: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated, and the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
items.description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
items.description: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData. This helps improve coverage by detecting and protecting sensitive data in these locations.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
items.description: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Enhanced Policy Conditions
items.description: Three updates are coming to enhance policy conditions. First, our updated policy conditions enable the detection of messages sent and received both to and from external email addresses, allowing you to identify specific instances of information being shared with external contacts. Secondly, with the new OR condition capability, you can combine multiple conditions within the same policy, creating custom logic to suit your unique compliance requirements. Lastly, to make policy creation and updates a seamless process, we've introduced the ability to test conditions before implementing them. By us

items.title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on Microsoft Copilot Harness
items.description: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

items.title: Power Automate: AI-assisted UI Automation repair
items.description: A new agentic debug run feature will be available in the flow designer. The UI automation repair interface launches while the flow is running, validating each selector used in the flow. It then proposes a new selector in case an existing one does not work as expected, after the user captures the respective element for reference.

items.title: Power Pages: Track Power Pages performance and usage with monitor hub
items.description:
Power Pages is integrated into the monitor hub. This integration empowers site owners, makers, and administrators to access performance and usage insights directly within the monitor hub of the Power Platform admin center.

Metrics available

The following metrics will be surfaced in monitor hub:

•	Session count: Tracks the number of sessions.

•	Session duration: Measures the average time spent in a session.

•	Page load time: Captures the time it takes for a web page to fully load (P75).

•	Error rate: Measures the percentage of requests where pages become unresponsive or return component-l

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
items.description: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Allow users to translate PDF documents into their preferred language
items.description: Users will be able to translate full PDF documents directly within the native PDF viewer in Microsoft Edge. The translated document opens in a new tab, making it easier to access content in their preferred language.  Admins can control availability to this feature using the TranslateEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in DoD
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to the Microsoft 365 Department of Defense (DoD) environment, providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the DoD environment.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
items.description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
items.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook for Mac
items.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on Mac devices.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with list form in Workflows
items.description: Starts a workflow with a form to collect the information you need to run the rest of your workflow.

items.title: Outlook: Microsoft Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments
items.description: When composing an email in Outlook for Mac, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be automatically applied or recommended based on the sensitivity labels of attached files. This helps users consistently protect sensitive information, reduces manual labeling effort, and supports organizational compliance requirements by aligning email protection with the sensitivity of attached content.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachment for iOS and Android
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance from attachments. When users attach files with sensitivity labels, Outlook can automatically apply or recommend an email sensitivity label based on organizational policy settings. This helps organizations maintain consistent data classification and protection while reducing manual labeling effort.

items.title: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
items.description: OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
items.description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

items.title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
items.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Helps You Discover People
items.description: Now Copilot Search can return matching people for your broader people search queries. Allowing you to discover, disambiguate, and explore known and new people to contact. Discover Whether you're looking for people with a specific skill like "Project leadership" or "Artificial Intelligence" Copilot Search can help you explore potential contacts through the People data source. Disambiguate When there are multiple people matching in exact name, email, or alias Copilot Search will help you disambiguate through a new carousel on the main results page alongside other relevant results.

items.title: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
items.description: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.

items.title: Power Pages: First Class Support for Connector APIs in Power Pages
items.description:
Native connectors support through Power Pages will allow organizations to securely connect their websites/portals directly to enterprise systems such as SQL, SAP, and Oracle, without building or maintaining custom integration layers.

This capability is especially valuable for regulated and enterprise customers such as banking and financial services, who need to surface data from systems hosted behind corporate firewalls. By leveraging the Power Platform on-premises data gateway and connector framework, customers can reduce integration complexity, lower operational costs, and accelerate delive

items.title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
items.description: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
items.description: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.

items.title: Outlook: Multiple Intune Accounts in Outlook for Android
items.description: Multiple MAM (Mobile Application Management) Intune Accounts will now be supported in Outlook for Android. Only one MDM (Mobile Device Management) account will be supported at a time per device.

items.title: PowerPoint: Clear view-only messaging
items.description: When you open a presentation you don't have permission to edit, PowerPoint now shows a clear "Viewing Only" message bar. It explains that the file is view-only, shows who created it, and tells you to contact the owner if you need more access.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax. Create richer, more readable messages while staying in the Markdown authoring experience.

items.title: Planner: Task History
items.description: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.

items.title: Planner: Conditional Coloring
items.description: Conditional Coloring highlight tasks based on selected criteria, making priorities, status, and important task details easier to spot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
items.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calendar view on the panel device. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

items.title: Planner: Capacity view
items.description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.

items.title: Outlook: Reply with a Template in Rules
items.description: You can now create a rule that automatically replies to incoming messages with a template you've set up. Set the conditions you care about and pick the template, and Outlook handles the response for you. It's a simple way to send consistent replies without typing the same thing over and over. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
items.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
items.description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications in case of any data loss incident that may occur due to a misconfigured policy or regression. Prior

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
items.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning issues, or compliance risk, simplifying high-volume, structured document workflows across the organizat

items.title: Power Apps: Model-driven apps - Use row summaries in US Government clouds
items.description:
Row summaries are expanding to supported US Government clouds, giving users in regulated environments access to AI-generated insights that help them understand model-driven app records at a glance. This release brings the row summary experience available to commercial customers to supported government environments while meeting their applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.

Admins and makers enable and configure row summaries for users in their model-driven apps.

items.title: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Configure site analytics and server logging
items.description:
Gain insights into your Power Pages site with integrated telemetry and analytics. Use Application Insights to monitor page views, form interactions, session details, and client-side analytics. Detect server-side errors, performance issues, and access logs to resolve problems and optimize your site.

To configure site analytics, makers must open the setup workspace and add the analytics provider script to enable traffic analytics.

Business Value:

You can monitor your Power Pages site traffic and user interactions with ease. Track page views, form interactions, and session details using client

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Modify and override submitted evaluations
items.description:
This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired. While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or errors in manual assessments.

In edit mode, supervisors can update evaluation responses, adjust scores, and refine comments to reflect an accurate assessment. This ensures that evaluation records represent the final, validated view of agent performance and interaction quality. T

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
items.description:
AI agents in Business Central
Business Central introduces AI agents to help users automate repetitive tasks and make business processes more intelligent and efficient. These agents act as specialized assistants that understand context, handle structured data, and collaborate with users to complete end-to-end workflows. For example, the Sales Order Agent simplifies order creation by transforming natural language or email instructions into complete sales documents, while the Payables Agent streamlines vendor invoice processing by extracting key details from incoming invoices and matching them to

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policy
items.description:
Create and enforce policies that prevent risky or noncompliant customer communications.

Governance policy checks serve as configurable safeguards that review AI‑generated and autonomous email responses before they are sent to customers. These checks enforce business, legal, and regulatory requirements by validating responses for relevance, prohibited content, and sensitive topics. If a response fails a policy check, delivery is blocked and the violation is clearly identified, enabling supervisors to review issues and take actions to improve outcomes.

Governance policies are applied consisten

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
items.description:
You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules.

Each agent instance tracks its own KPI metrics, such as emails received, quotes created, orders created, and time saved. items.description:
As a sales leader, you can configure a Sales Development agent once, then share or clone its configuration across your organization. Distribute the agent’s playbook, guidelines, guardrails, and settings to other business units to provide a consistent experience across sales teams.

The feature supports these capabilities:

Agentic simulations are an AI-driven capability of Service Operations Agent that enable organizations to evaluate how their contact center behaves under realistic customer conditions before those conditions occur in production.

Administrators define simulation scenarios using natural-language prompts. Agentic simulations then generate realistic synthetic conversations, runs them end-to-end through the configured contact center, and calculates the contact center KPIs.

items.title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive/SharePoint web viewer
items.description: We're enabling PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. With this update, users who have the appropriate usage rights can annotate these protected PDFs in place in their browser while preserving the file's sensitivity label, encryption, and usage rights when changes are saved.

items.title: SharePoint: Copilot Search in SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: Copilot Search brings AI-powered, natural-language search to SharePoint and OneDrive, combining relevant results, AI-generated summaries with source references, intuitive filters, and a seamless handoff to Copilot.

items.title: Power Apps: Prompt Columns - multiple lines of text output

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Prompt column values in bulk for existing records (backfill)

Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk, optionally filtered to just the rows they need, so historical data gets the same AI-generated insights as incoming data, without touching each record one at a time.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
items.description: Gain proactive visibility into meeting quality across your organization with AI-powered insights in the Teams admin center that identify emerging patterns, highlight impacted users and locations, and surface likely causes with recommended actions. This helps IT administrators detect and address issues earlier, improve meeting quality, and stay ahead of potential disruptions.

items.title: Excel: Excel canvas
items.description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.154 - Sign in to Edge with a Google account
items.description: Users can now sign in to Microsoft Edge using a Google account in addition to the Microsoft account from the profile menu and Edge sign-in screen. Available for Windows and macOS devices.  Admins can control availability to this feature using the NonMicrosoftAccountSignInEnabled policy.

items.title: Access: Rounded corners on Access form controls
items.description: We’re making it easier to give your Access apps a polished, up-to-date feel. With the new CornerRadius property, you can add rounded corners to form controls—bringing a softer, more modern look to your designs.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Watermarking Protection
items.description: Watermarking Protection in Microsoft Edge helps organizations visibly reinforce data protection policies by overlaying a persistent watermark on sensitive content viewed in the browser. This feature is designed to deter unauthorized sharing, support compliance efforts, and increase user awareness when handling confidential information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot response personalization - Memory citations
items.description: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer. Select Sources beneath the response, then open the Personalization tab to view the custom instructions, saved memories, memories learned from conversations, and past chats that shaped the response. From there, users can return to a cited chat to pick up where they left off or review and delete saved memories. Memory citations appear only when memory is turned on.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
items.description:
Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving.

- Improved context handling and support for larger plans.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC

items.description: Today, IT admins manually review trust data for Teams apps and agents in the Teams admin center to ensure they meet organizational security, privacy, and compliance standards. This feature introduces a scalable, automated evaluation process. Admins can define their organization’s trust requirements once, and the system will automatically assess each app and agent—generating an evaluation score and detailed evaluation report tailored to those requirements. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Co-organizer updates in Webinars

It ensures secure claim transmission, improves compatibility with advanced identity providers, and strengthens overall authentication security without changing existing sign-in flows.

Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply, and configuration is optional for organizations choosing to use Administrative Unit (AU)-scoped management.

items.description: The Microsoft Visio Desktop MCP Server enables compatible AI clients to connect with the Visio Desktop application to create, read, and update Visio diagrams using natural language. It runs locally on Windows and requires a licensed Visio Desktop application.

- Cozy

Each density setting adjusts layout spacing while maintaining accessibility target-size requirements. User preferences take precedence over administrator-configured defaults.

items.description: Power Apps model-driven apps are now available as Business Apps in Work IQ. In either experience, natural-language prompts let users list and read records or create, update, and delete them. For create and update, Work IQ maps supplied values to the appropriate app fields. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Rule-based tagging and auto-resolution of alerts based on business needs of the customer.

Alert auto-resolution & tagging rules let you tell DLP, in advance, how to handle predictable alerts. You define a rule once, and from then on DLP applies it automatically to every new alert:

● Resolve alerts you don't need to see - e.g., Low-severity alerts for mail sent only to your trusted partner domains, so they never reach your triage queue.

● Tag alerts so you can find and route them - e.g., label every alert from your Legal department as a “Business Process”.

items.description: When files are opened in Windows, the operating system, and applications (for example, Microsoft Office and browsers) can create, rename, and delete temporary files as part of normal behavior. items.description: Stay connected to your team’s engagement with Viva Insights Workplace Metrics, available alongside your survey results in Viva Glint.
