This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP and PDF (image only PDF).

items.title: Outlook: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
items.description: The first updates will focus on visual details, such as icons, spacing and alignment. Users of classic Outlook for Windows will begin seeing refinements to familiar mail and calendar surfaces. The initial visual updates are intended to improve clarity and consistency without changing how users perform their tasks.

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.description: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat.  Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
items.description: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Security Copilot agents to automate tasks like triage and policy management. Plus, Purview now extends cov

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
items.description: Meeting organizers can now easily delete meeting generated content including recording, transcript, AI summary, and notes through the new delete button in recap page. Shared files in the meeting won't be deleted.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
items.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
items.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

items.title: Outlook: Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot available in Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac
items.description: We will be adding declarative agents support in Copilot Chat in Outlook. This roadmap item tracks availability in Outlook for Mac.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls.  Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing and acting on detection signals from supported providers.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
items.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
items.description: Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
items.description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

items.title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
items.description: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
items.description: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
items.description: A new export functionality will be introduced in two locations: the Data Loss Prevention > Policies page and the Information Protection > Label publishing policies page. This feature will allow users to export their existing DLP configurations and label policies, including schema, as a downloadable ZIP file. The exported file can be attached to support tickets to accelerate troubleshooting.

items.title: Excel: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel
items.description: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. This makes it easier to tackle multi step or high impact tasks while staying in control of every change.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Adding contextual nudges to the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon
items.description: Edge for Business will soon help users quickly take contextual action on their open pages using contextual nudges attached to the Copilot icon in the toolbar

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s)
items.description: Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s).

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Overview of recent comments and changes in Word
items.description: Use Copilot to see a summary of the latest comments and changes made to your Word files using the Copilot chat pane.

items.title: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
items.description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Increase in expansion limit for auto-expanding archive beyond 1.5 TB
items.description: Previously, auto-expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archives beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

items.title: Power Automate: Build and visualize desktop flows using Flowchart mode
items.description: Flowchart mode introduces a new visual authoring experience in Power Automate for desktop that allows makers to create, view, and edit desktop flows using a flowchart representation. Actions are displayed as connected nodes and execution paths are represented visually, making it easier to understand, build, and maintain complex automations that include conditions, loops, and branching logic. Makers can create new flows directly in Flowchart mode or switch existing flows between Sequence mode and Flowchart mode.

items.title: Power Automate: Schedule desktop flows directly with Scheduled Triggers
items.description: Scheduled triggers enable makers to run desktop flows on a recurring schedule directly from the Power Automate automation center, eliminating the need to create and manage intermediary scheduled cloud flows. Users can configure daily, weekly, monthly, hourly, or custom recurrence patterns, select the execution machine or machine group, and monitor upcoming scheduled runs from a centralized experience. Scheduled Triggers simplify desktop automation management and provide a more intuitive scheduling experience for attended and unattended desktop flows.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.

items.title: Outlook: Right-click to customize the classic ribbon
items.description: You can now customize the classic ribbon in New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the Web by right-clicking the ribbon and choosing which commands and groups appear on the Home and View tabs. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Identify custom apps that need updates for Teams private and shared channels
items.description: Admins will be able to view in Teams Admin Center a list of custom apps in their tenant that need to be updated to work in private and shared channels. This experience will help admins identify impacted apps, understand which apps require developer action, and coordinate updates so users can continue using custom apps across all supported channel types.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Prevent presence transition to "Do not disturb" setting when screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
items.description: We're introducing a setting that allows users to opt-out of transitioning presence automatically to Do Not Disturb when presenting or screen sharing. This ensures that they can continue to receive calls, keeping them connected and responsive without manual presence adjustments.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Collection and DLP Policies for Intune-Policy Managed Apps
items.description: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling organizations to apply content‑aware protection policies to sensitive data on mobile devices. This integration ensures that clipboard actions in managed mobile apps are evaluated against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed, helping reduce data leakage, insider risk, and exposure to advanced threats across mobile workflows. Additionally, Microsoft Purview Collection policies can be used to govern how sensitive data

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
items.description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New layout when sharing content for Teams events
items.description: Organizers and presenters who have access to production tools will see updated layout options when sharing content in the "Manage what attendees see" experience for Teams events. The available layouts are "Speaker focused", "Content focused", and "Content only". The new Speaker focused layout prioritizes presenter video alongside shared content for greater visibility. This feature is available for Teams events organizers with a Teams Enterprise license. This feature is available on Teams for Windows desktop and Mac desktop.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding note capabilities across alerts & cases
items.description: We’re introducing a new collaboration capability in Insider Risk Management that enables analysts and investigators to add notes directly within alerts. With this feature, users can document investigation progress, share findings, and capture key context throughout the triage process. In addition to manually added notes, system‑generated notes will automatically record updates such as alert status changes or user assignments — helping teams maintain a clear and auditable investigation timeline. By centralizing investigation history directly within alerts, this update helps improve collaboratio

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Enhanced user profile in IRM alerts
items.description: We’re enhancing the User section within Insider Risk Management alerts to provide investigators with more contextual user profile and risk attributes directly within their workflow. With this update, analysts can now view key user details such as employee type, office location, start date, policy inclusion, priority user group status, and last working day—helping them build a more complete understanding of the user during investigations without navigating away from the alert experience. This feature will be available as part of the new alert workflow through the Alert Details panel. Additional

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dataverse data connected to Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Let people search and query Dataverse business data from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
items.description: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

items.title: Outlook: Choose to Show Unread or Total Count for Each Folder
items.description: You can now pick whether each folder in your folder pane shows the unread count or the total item count. Until now, Outlook only displayed unread counts, but sometimes you need to see how many items are in a folder overall. Just right-click any folder and choose whether to show the total or unread count. It gives you more control over how you keep track of your email without changing how anything else works. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Use sensitivity labels to block all connected experiences that analyze content in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
items.description: In Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, the ‘Prevent some connected experiences that analyze content’ label setting now prevents files in these apps from being sent to all Microsoft connected experiences for analysis, rather than a subset of these connected experiences.

items.title: Outlook: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Policy Tips & Override in Outlook for Mac
items.description: Outlook for Mac now supports Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips, helping users avoid accidental data leaks. When sensitive content is detected, users are alerted with inline tips or pop-ups, based on admin-configured rules.

items.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
items.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Optical character recognition (OCR) support for SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business
items.description: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data in SharePoint Online and OneDrive. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, and PDF (image-only PDF).

items.title: SharePoint: Advanced Management - Inactive files policy
items.description: SharePoint administrators can use the Inactive files policy in SharePoint Advanced Management to automatically archive files based on when they were last accessed. The public preview is available through PowerShell only. Admins can set an inactivity threshold from 6 to 48 months, scope policies to all SharePoint sites or selected sites, include or exclude file types and sites, and use What-If mode to review impact before activation. Eligible files move to the Microsoft 365 Archive cold-storage tier while remaining in place and retaining their metadata, permissions, compliance, and searchabilit

items.title: OneDrive: Presentation mode for PDFs in the iOS app on iPad
items.description: Microsoft OneDrive is introducing presentation mode in the OneDrive iOS app for users on iPad devices. Users select a new Presentation button in the PDF viewer to enter a focused, view-only experience that prevents free gesture scrolling between pages, reducing accidental page changes while presenting without moving the file to another app. The feature is not available on iPhone.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
items.description: A new feature will be introduced on the main Classification page, allowing users to test files against all available classifiers to identify the presence of sensitive information. Users will have the option to select a single classifier or run tests across all classifiers. This capability is designed to help users identify sensitive content within files and troubleshoot classification issues more efficiently.

items.title: Outlook: New Outlook for Windows for GCC-H and DoD
items.description: The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will be available for US Government clouds (GCC-H and DoD sovereign environments).

items.title: Outlook: Improved PDF Preview on iOS
items.description: MIP-label protected PDFs are now supported in the PDF previewer along with a built-in control's toolbar for easier navigation.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
items.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
items.description: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “Approved by”.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
items.description: With Teams Rooms on Windows consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
items.description:
The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.

The update focuses on improving underlying performance, consistency in design elements, and a smoother interaction without altering any existing workflows for users.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
items.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
items.description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Adding support for viewing Sensitivity labels applied to a Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) Protected PDF
items.description: Enterprise customers can view sensitivity labels applied to MIP protected PDF to be well informed of the data classification to enable them to handle such sensitive documents. This change will be available in the new PDF viewer on Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
items.description: Help people get started faster by automatically connecting new team members to relevant channels when they join a team. Improve engagement, accelerate onboarding, and make it easier to discover important information from day one.

items.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
items.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
items.description: Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies. Sales Agent uses the instructions in Business

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys - AI-powered task completion for Microsoft 365 Copilot users
items.description: Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will be available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium license in Edge.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Migrate finance and operations environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
items.description: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
items.description: B2B users, including internal guest users and external users, will be able to register and sign in with passkeys issued by a resource tenant to meet that tenant's multifactor authentication (MFA) requirements. Today, passkeys are supported for member users in their home tenant. With this update, B2B users can register a resource tenant passkey from the resource tenant's My Security Info page, or in-line during a proof-up prompt or passkey registration campaign, and then use it to satisfy the resource tenant's MFA requirements. This change is on by default. B2B users already in scope for passke

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds
items.description: Microsoft Teams can now detect and warn users on malicious URLs sent in Teams chat and channels in Gov clouds, increasing protection against malware attacks for Gov clouds customers.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Different Content to Learning Groups in a Single Assignment
items.description:
Enable educators to assign different content (attachments, resources, instructions) to different Individual Groups within a single Assignment. Today teachers must create separate assignments to differentiate — one for advanced readers, another for struggling students, etc. This feature collapses that into one assignment with group-specific content mapping.

Key capabilities:

Map different content to different Individual Groups within one Assignment

Students only see content assigned to their group

Clear group-to-content mapping visible to the educator before publishing

Differentiated conte

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Admin assignment time limit
items.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing the ability to set a limit in days when assigning users and security groups to role groups. This allows admins to define a fixed duration when providing admin permission on a temporary basis.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: View only Role management enhancements
items.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing a new view-only role management role to give admins permissions to see all the member assignments in Purview and Defender portal. This addition will be added to Global Reader and Security Reader in Purview and Entra.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure user and survey data retention for deleted users in Viva Glint
items.description: With the new control in Viva Glint, service administrators can now configure whether to retain or delete survey and relevant indefinable user data for users who are manually deleted from Glint or deleted via the signals received via Microsoft Entra. This will ensure that the consistency of previously generate Glint survey reports is retained and user data is handled in accordance with the relevant organizational policies. We will also process the delete signals received via Microsoft Entra and handle the corresponding user data retention or deletion as per our terms of service.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
items.description:
Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Adaptive card-based app & copilot agent link unfurling in Teams
items.description: Discover and add SharePoint agents in chats and channels from in-context store. Users can click on 'Add agents and bots' from the roster drop down. This will open the in-context store, where users can discover SharePoint agents and add them directly to the conversation and collaborate in the group. Updated January 29, 2026: Due to a blocker we have paused rollout until March for this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Self-learning for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Soon agents can help makers improve agents using lessons from completed runs. It will identify repeated tool sequences that can be handled by workflows to standardize agent behavior, minimize errors, and most importantly control costs. Makers will be presented with recommendations and supporting evidence, expected impact, and the related instruction and tool changes. Makers accept recommendations, configure, test, and publish a refined copy of the agent. This helps improve agent output quality and controls costs while preserving work that requires model judgment and keeping makers in control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Makers can now give their Copilot Studio agents their own accounts, making it a governed Microsoft 365 identity for shared, collaborative business processes that spans across teams. With its own mailbox, Teams presence & Office access, the agent can collaborate where work happens while admins can control and govern its access, policies and use as its own first-class entity.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
items.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the call.

items.title: Outlook: Filter Messages by Events
items.description: You can now filter your messages for calendar invitations. Simply go to the filter and select Events from the drop down.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
items.description: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

items.title: Outlook: Drag and Drop
items.description: You can now reschedule events by dragging them to a new time slot in your calendar. This feature is available in day and multi day views.

items.title: Outlook: Follow meetings in Outlook mobile
items.description: If you're unable to attend a meeting, you can select Follow as your response to help you stay informed of the meeting events. Following a meeting reminds the organizer to record the meeting and alert you to any follow-up items.

items.title: Outlook: Work week view for Outlook iOS and iPad
items.description: You can now use a work week calendar view on iOS and iPad to focus on the days you work. On iPad, you can select "work week" directly from the view picker. On iOS, you can select work week from the view picker when you rotate your device to landscape. You can choose which days are included in your work week by syncing from your default account or by customizing the days just for your device.

items.title: Outlook: Keep Invitations After Responding in Outlook Mobile
items.description: You can now control whether meeting invitations are automatically removed from your inbox after you RSVP. Simply to go to settings, calendar, and turn off or on "Delete Invite After RSVP."

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Auto-Archive for Exchange Online
items.description: A new capability called Auto-Archiving for Exchange Online will enter public preview in November 2025 (currently under private preview for selected customers). When a user's mailbox utilization exceeds 95% of its quota and archive mailbox is present, this feature automatically moves the oldest items excluding those tagged with “Never Move to Archive” from the primary mailbox to the archive mailbox to prevent mail flow disruptions by keeping usage below the safe threshold of 95% of mailbox quota.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Deep citations in Copilot
items.description: Deep citations let users quickly verify Copilot's results by linking directly to the relevant part of the reference, boosting trust. We're starting with Word and PPT files, then adding Meetings, Web, and PDF references.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Show remote machine information on File Copy to Remote Desktop
items.description: Admin should be able to see destination machine information when end-user copy a sensitive file to a remote machine through RDP.

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook Mobile
items.description: DLP policy tip support for Outlook Mobile enhances data loss prevention measures on mobile devices by providing real-time alerts to help users avoid accidentally sharing sensitive information, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog
items.description: With the Skills catalog in Copilot Studio, makers can discover, reuse and selectively share approved organizational skills instead of recreating the same instructions and workflows for every agent. The shared catalog powered by Microsoft 365 App Store enables shared skills to extend across experiences such as Copilot Studio M365 copilot, and Cowork, helping organizations standardize proven ways of working while maintaining centralized governance.

items.title: Work IQ: ExpandedContextIQ
items.description: Expand Context IQ so users can discover and select additional agents, skills, and content sources while composing prompts.

items.title: Work IQ: Custom agents + 3P calls
items.description: Enable Work IQ to invoke custom agents and agents that call supported third-party tools.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 admin center - Usage reports - Copilot Chat for GCC, GCC High and DoD
items.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Copilot Chat. This report will include total active users, Copilot Chat usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Policy Recommendation Panel in IRM
items.description:
Today, Insider Risk Management (IRM) provides policy-driven protection for data leaks, data theft, and risky AI usage. However, while policy-driven protections are powerful, customers may not always have clear visibility into where coverage can be optimized or expanded to address latent insider risk.

IRM now provides guidance on what protections are missing or which policy configurations deliver the most incremental value, providing customers with more comprehensive coverage to mitigate their most critical insider risk.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Change Meeting Organizer via PowerShell Cmdlet in Exchange Online
items.description: Allows the administrator of an Exchange Online tenant to change the organizer of an existing meeting or meeting series via a PowerShell cmdlet. This can be used, for example, to maintain continuity and history of a long-running meeting series in cases where the meeting organizer has a new role, is on leave, or during the offboarding process. Once the meeting is transferred, the new organizer will be able to maintain all properties of the event including meeting time and recurrence, attendees, and description. Meeting attendees within the Exchange Online tenant will not need to re-RSVP and the

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Excel Agent
items.description: Excel Agent helps you turn data into clear charts, summaries, and insights using built‑in formulas and logic. It streamlines data preparation, formulas, and visualization so you can stay focused on the story behind the numbers. Use multi‑turn chat to refine your output or open it in Excel for full editing and collaboration. Ideal for financial forecasts, project plans, and decision‑making tools. Available to Microsoft 365 users with or without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Live subtitles on voice chat in Copilot when using the quick composer
items.description: Live subtitles for voice chats in Copilot will be available for users to help them follow the conversation when using the quick composer.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation updates
items.description: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub. Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge. Preview and playback video directly in chat, then continue iterating towards a finished video.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
items.description: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing software investments and unlocks more surfaces for the tools their users already rely on.

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
items.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection- Scan existing files in SharePoint and OneDrive for business for sensitive information
items.description: This new capability will enable admins to scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for business for sensitive data.

items.title: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
items.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, and Focus Areas created will be visible and filterable with this report.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. Controls are available when Teams Rooms can confirm the camera isn't independently framing the room.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity label grouping modernization
items.description: To help improve label usability and configuration, the sensitivity labeling scheme will be simplified to only consist of labels and label groupings. These new label groupings allow admins to better organize and categorize their labels (previously done via parent labels).

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
items.description:
The Maker guidelines feature gives organizations a direct way to share guidance with Copilot Studio makers in the flow of work. Administrators can explain which tools, models, connectors, and channels are approved for an environment and point makers to the right policy, request process, or support contact.

The message appears in the Review pane alongside the agent's blockers and warnings and remains available when the agent has no issues. This gives makers a consistent place to understand organizational expectations and find help without leaving Copilot Studio.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
items.description: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. With IntelliFrame’s expanded AI data channel, participants experience faster active speaker framing, people recognition and labels, and more responsive meeting views—even when network conditions are limited. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Outlook: Insert Symbol
items.description: You can insert a variety of symbols into an email message while composing it. To add a symbol, go to the Insert tab and select Symbols.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Schedule Channel Meetings from Outlook Calendar
items.description: Users will be able to schedule Microsoft Teams channel meetings directly from Outlook Calendar. This streamlines meeting creation and helps keep discussions and meeting content connected in the appropriate channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Schedule Teams Channel Meeting from Win32
items.description: Users can now schedule Teams Channel Meetings from Win32 (Outlook classic client)

items.title:
Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person
meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
items.description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts. In DSI, define your endpoint DLP query (for example, time range, users, and endpoints). DSI then automatically gathers the related files that triggered the alerts for review (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
items.description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation snapshot but were processed during enforcement.

items.title: PowerPoint: Skills in Brand Kit
items.description: Upload skill (.md file) in Brand Kit and use within PPT Copilot

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local inferencing
items.description:
Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography.

Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produce an output or response.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage: New left navigation controls — collapse, resize, increased favorites cap, and reorder favorites capabilities
items.description: We're introducing a set of left-navigation improvements in Viva Engage on the web that give people more control over their navigation pane. These are additive, user-driven changes — users can collapse the left nav, resize its width, favorite up to 50 communities, and drag to reorder their favorited communities. None of these changes alter which destinations appear in the navigation. These enhancements are applicable to all surfaces that have the Engage left navigation menu - Web, and the Engage app in Teams and Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts
items.description: Microsoft Teams preserves @mentions and shared contacts when you copy and paste messages in chats and channels. Instead of defaulting to plain text, Teams intelligently displays an @mention, shared contact, or plain text based on where the content is pasted, reducing manual rework.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
items.description: You can now reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
items.description: You can now attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
items.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
items.description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
items.description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
items.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis
items.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.

items.title: SharePoint: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
items.description: Recipient groups in eSignature allow a recipient slot to be assigned to multiple people, such that any one  of those people can fulfil the signing requirement on behalf of the group.

items.title: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
items.description: This feature empowers authors to create rich, interactive charts with AI in SharePoint when editing SharePoint pages. Authors can describe the chart they want to create in plain language within a chat on a SharePoint page.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention– Unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
items.description: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Island, extending protection to Island’s browser-based workflows at the point of user interaction. With this integration, new and existing Island customers can configure Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention policies to detect and protect data shared with unmanaged cloud apps through the Island Enterprise Browser, the Island Extension, and browser add ins via HTTP and HTTPS, using the same classifiers, sensitive information types, and sensitivity labels used in other Purview policies. items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
items.description: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, under Copilot > Search > Authoritative content, add and manage up to 100 SharePoint sites. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot Cowork makes it easy to delegate work. Describe the outcome you want and Cowork automatically grounds the work in your emails, meetings, messages, files, and data.

items.title: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
items.description: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. This feature automatically expires and deletes meeting-created plans that have had no task activity for 180 days. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

items.title: PowerPoint: Create on brand presentations with additional brand assets
items.description: Seamlessly access your brand colors, images, icons, logos and more right within PowerPoint to create on-brand presentations.

items.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention — Endpoint DLP now supports a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition
items.description: Endpoint DLP now includes a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition. Previously, file extensions were entered as free form text, which could result in unsupported or non-scannable extensions being used. This could lead to gaps in protection and increase processing overhead on endpoints. With the pre curated list, you can select only supported file extensions. This helps improve policy reliability and reduces unnecessary processing on endpoints.

items.title: Outlook: Multi Account Search
items.description: Users will be able to see results from multiple mailboxes interweaved in a single ranked list and will be able to do standard mail actions.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Optional Public CDN Support in Brand Center Setup
items.description:
We are updating the Brand Center setup experience so that administrators can set up Brand Center without enabling Public CDN.

Today, Public CDN is enabled as part of Brand Center setup, even when an organization only wants to use branding governance capabilities that do not require it. With this update, organizations can begin using Brand Center while deferring Public CDN until they need capabilities that depend on it, such as organizational fonts.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Explicit recording and transcription consent for PSTN participants now available in GCC High and DoD
items.description: We are introducing explicit recording and transcription consent support for PSTN participants joining Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD environments. This feature is already available in Public and GCC clouds and is now being extended to sovereign environments. After this rollout, when a meeting is being recorded or transcribed, PSTN participants will be prompted to provide explicit consent before they can unmute and participate. items.title: SharePoint: New Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
items.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android is redesigned around the personalized SharePoint Discover experience, bringing your most relevant files, sites, people, and news together in one place, with improved site browsing, in-app file previews, refreshed news and search, dark mode, and better performance.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
items.description: Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
items.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Power user insights in Copilot dashboard
items.description: Understand who is building a habit using Copilot with the new power user insights in Copilot dashboard

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Add references to your Copilot Notebooks from the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app
items.description: Users can quickly add references to a Copilot Notebook through the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Metadata understanding support for queries scoped to SharePoint document libraries or folders
items.description: We’re introducing column metadata support for queries in Microsoft 365 Copilot when a SharePoint library or folder is attached or its URL is provided. This enhancement improves contextual relevance by enabling Copilot to leverage additional metadata from the selected library, delivering more accurate and meaningful results.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations integration
items.description: Launch a pre-scoped Data Security Investigation (DSI) from an IRM case. When a data security admin identifies a risky user who needs deeper investigation, they can launch a pre-scoped investigation directly from an IRM case, allowing them to view content analysis related to that user and better assess post-incident data impact. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own in

items.description: With this update, Microsoft Purview will start supporting collection policies. Collection policies allow customers to scope classification (SITs - Sensitive Information Types) and activities for scoped users. We recommend reviewing collection policies as they can be created by different Purview solution admins to ensure they are setup to detect the activities required by Insider Risk Management policies Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Expanding access to Diagnostics to Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management
items.description: We are expanding the access to Diagnostics beyond Global Admin to: Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity Label support in Engage
items.description: Your organization can now manually apply Information Protection sensitivity labels in Engage. Sensitivity label support in this new application will allow admins to create labels and configure label publishing policies to determine which users and groups can manually label content in Engage. End users will be able to manually apply labels to Engage communities and in turn classify and protect their sensitive data via privacy and external user access controls.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Endpoint DLP shows full path of target domain
items.description: Endpoint DLP should show full path of target domain and not just the domain name in Activity Explorer.

items.title: Outlook: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
items.description: If you don’t want to check spelling manually for every message—or you’re worried you might forget!—you can set Outlook to check spelling for you every time before sending emails.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Monitor tab
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within Monitor tab at both a per-agent level and an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage, helping connect overall consumption to specific actions and experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Agent Evaluations
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly associated with their evaluations, including a breakdown of usage for eval generation, test runs and model grading/judgement. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage transparent throughout the development lifecycle.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.
