items.title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Windows Desktop)
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.153 - Changes to local IP address detection for proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts
items.description: Microsoft Edge is changing how it selects the local network address reported to proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts and is adding administrator control over it. The default IPv4 and IPv6 probe destinations now match Chromium’s defaults. Administrators can override these defaults using the PacMyIpAddressIPv4ProbeAddress and PacMyIpAddressIPv6ProbeAddress policies when required by their network routing.

items.title: OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
items.description: OneDrive for Windows and Mac will let users exclude specific folders from syncing, so folders that do not belong in the cloud, such as developer tooling folders like PowerShell modules, Visual Studio configuration, and node modules, stay local on the device instead of uploading to OneDrive. Administrators can define folder exclusion rules for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
items.description: The new chats and channels experience introduced quick views at the top of the chat and channels list. These are views into mentions, followed threads and more. This update allows users to choose when and how these quick views are shown. Users will have options such as always show, always hide and show only when unread. Users will also be able to collapse the quick views section.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics: Copilot usage snapshot PBI at day level with fresh data
items.description: A day level Copilot adoption Power BI report reflecting the most recent copilot activity & freshest insights.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
items.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint data loss prevention is expanding coverage to Copilot + PCs initially to support Recall snapshots and determining whether policies exist to prevent capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and Sensitive information types (SITs). Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.153 - Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
items.description: Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows.  Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Semantic Goodbye word for voice in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Now users can close a voice session on Windows by simply saying bye or goodbye when they want to close voice session. This, paired with "Hey Copilot" wake word, provides them with complete hands-free experience for voice in Microsoft 365 Copilot on Windows devices.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility]​​[Search UX] Rich entity representation for connectors in Search results
items.description: Rich entity representation for connectors in Search results.

items.title: Outlook: New Cloud Policy controls
items.description: We’re introducing Cloud Policy service support for Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows. Admins can set default values for supported Outlook settings and choose whether users can change them, providing consistent cloud-based control across their organization

items.title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the OneDrive apps (iOS and Android)
items.description: The Microsoft OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will let users annotate PDFs protected by a Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity label that applies encryption — without removing or weakening the label. Users with edit/annotate rights can add a full set of annotations — including ink, highlight, free text, notes, signatures, image/shape/date stamps, bookmarks, and form fields — directly in the OneDrive mobile PDF viewer; the file's encryption and usage rights are preserved end to end. This applies to the OneDrive apps for iOS and Android only (not OneDrive or SharePoint on the w

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Allow customer to scope JIT Audit to specific user or user group
items.description: Enable customers to include or exclude users/user groups from Just‑In‑Time (JIT) Audit, ensuring audits are generated only for the selected users or groups.

items.title: Access: Zooming for Continuous Forms and Multiple-Items Forms
items.description: Access extends zoom capabilities to continuous forms and pop-up forms, building on zoom support already available in tables and queries. Adjust magnification from 10 percent to 500 percent using the slider in the lower-right corner or controls on the ribbon. Keyboard shortcuts are also available, making it easy to quickly change your view and focus on the details that matter most.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Settings in classic Outlook for Windows
items.description: You will now be able to access different Copilot settings directly in classic Outlook for Windows.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Introducing Exchange Online Cross-tenant Message Recall
items.description: We're enhancing the Exchange Online Message Recall feature to add support for cross-tenant recalls. Today, you can recall messages only within your organization. Cross-tenant recall will let you recall messages sent to other organizations that add your tenant to their recall allow list.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-M will able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Access: Enable zoom magnification to Microsoft Access for Forms, Tables, Queries
items.description: Access will add magnification slider (10% to 500%) in lower right of the application, similar to the feature in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. It will also be keyboard accessible and available on the ribbon in Access forms, tables, and queries.

items.title: Word: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Coordinated meetings support on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Teams Rooms on Android now supports coordinated meetings, enabling paired Teams Rooms on Android devices and Android-based touch boards to work together in the same hybrid meeting experience. This feature enables coordinated join and leave, and collaboration across front-of-room displays and touch boards. This creates more immersive and flexible meeting spaces for both in-room and remote participants.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Insights: Copilot Analytics - Cowork adoption and impact
items.description: Deeper insights into Cowork adoption and impact accessible from the new AI Cost dashboard and Copilot dashboard. Includes export capability. All metrics can be queried by analysts with the new AI cost query in advanced insights.

items.title: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

items.title: OneDrive: Refreshed Libraries View in OneDrive Web
items.description: We're replacing the existing More places experience in OneDrive Web with a refreshed Libraries view. Users can see more recently accessed libraries, navigate to default document libraries for Teams and favorite SharePoint sites, and use new filtering, sorting, and view options.

items.title: OneDrive: Document library views now available in OneDrive
items.description: Users can now work with SharePoint document library views directly from OneDrive. In addition to switching between existing views, users can create and manage views to customize how library content is organized and displayed. This helps teams surface the information that matters most while staying within the OneDrive experience.

items.title: Outlook: Co-Authoring Highlight and Rewrite
items.description: Users can now collaborate with Copilot to make improvements to email drafts. Select a section of the draft and ask Copilot to make changes, like changing its length, tone, or structure.

items.title: Access: Cascading combo and list boxes with LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields
items.description: Combo boxes and list boxes now support LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields properties, enabling cascading dropdowns (e.g., Country filters City) without writing VBA code.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Archive File Classification Behavior Change for Windows Endpoints
items.description: We are updating archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints to align with cloud workloads. This change improves consistency, reduces noise in event reporting, and enhances performance when processing archive files.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
items.description: We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
items.description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
items.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. Updated August 18, 2026: Rollout timing of this feature is now planned for end of August through early September. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Excel: Extending support for Insights Services to GCC-H and DoD sovereign clouds
items.description: GCC-H and DoD sovereign cloud customers will be able to use features in Excel run by Insights Services, including Analyze Data found on the Data tab.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Topic Assignments Included in Comment Report Export
items.description: When exporting comments to spreadsheet from the Comments report, the topic(s) assigned to each comment will be included in the export.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GCC
items.description: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GGC provides Teams admins with insights into external collaboration patterns - covering teams, federated domains, channels, guests, and internal users - along with recommended actions to enhance security for external collaboration.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply a retention policy to Microsoft Planner content
items.description: Introducing Data lifecycle management capabilities for Microsoft Planner. Compliance admins can now create a retention policy to manage content located in Microsoft Planner such as tasks for plans associated with an Microsoft 365 Group.

items.title: Data Loss Prevention- DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
items.description:
Copilot for Security in DLP can summarize DLP policies. This enhancement enables DLP admins to gain insights on coverage of policies viz. location, classifiers and notifications, and more.

DLP admins can get these insights on all the policies or on few selected policies. They will be able to use prompts to gain deeper level view of how a policy is configured for their digital landscape. This helps them align their data posture on a regular basis and make corrections to policy posture as needed. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enhanced personalization with memory in Copilot
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will improve memory in Copilot by increasing the relevance and quality of Copilot responses based on previous communications. This AI-powered capability improves the relevance and quality of Copilot responses by learning from previous communications. These memories are private to the user.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
items.description: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.

items.title: Planner: Add times to task start, finish, and due dates
items.description: Add specific times to task start, finish, and due dates. Define a plan’s time zone and working hours to automatically provide default task times and choose whether to view times in the plan’s time zone or your local time zone. This helps distributed teams coordinate effectively across time zones and keep deadlines clear.

items.title: Outlook: Categorize Emails by Dragging Them onto a Favorite Category
items.description: You can now add a category to your Favorites and then drag emails right onto it to apply that category. No need to open menus or right-click each message. Just pin the category you use most to Favorites, then drop your emails on it to tag them in one quick motion. It's a faster, more visual way to keep your inbox sorted the way you like. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - DLM Meter Change
items.description: Data Lifecycle Management (DLM) billing will be based on the volume of data retained. For example, any number of non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompts and responses that collectively amount to 1 GB of retained data will be billed at $0.25 per GB per month (equivalent to ~$0.0082 per GB per day). In the updated model, DLM is billed based on the total volume of text messages managed by a DLM policy. Each non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompt and response is treated as an individual text message and is retained and deleted according to the configured Microsoft Purview retention settings. Billi

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Allow M365 authentication popups in work profiles
items.description: When users are signed in with a work account, some Microsoft 365 sites (for example, microsoft.com, cloud.microsoft, and microsoft365.com) may open authentication pop-up windows to Microsoft sign-in endpoints such as login.microsoftonline.com, login.live.com, or login.microsoft.com. These pop-ups are required to complete sign-in. Microsoft Edge now allows authentication pop-up windows from Microsoft first party services by default. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365AuthPopupsInWorkEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI Generated video drafts include text animations and new layout options
items.description: Users will find updated layouts and text animations on video projects generated with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Upgraded music selection for Copilot AI Videos
items.description: With a Microsoft365 Copilot license, Copilot AI-generated video projects have improved audio with realistic AI voiceover, professional sound effects, and enhanced audio mixing.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard at Day Level
items.description: This feature enables users to export fresher row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis at day level. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Introduction of secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies
items.description: The first release of Priority cleanup enables admins to create a recurring exception to delete items under a broader retention policy and/or legal hold on Exchange workload. Creating a Priority cleanup will require a separate security role, multiple approvers, and will have a complete audit trail.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: New text and shape animations in the video editor
items.description: Clipchamp Editor will support simple animations for text layers. Users can apply preset in/out animations, adjust how long the animation lasts, choose its direction, and preview the animated text in the editor prior to exporting. This capability will be available across web and native desktop versions of Clipchamp.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
items.description: This dashboard will allow admins to view the device health across all their devices to ensure the system is healthy and ready to receive policy updates and quickly identify devices that are not ready.

items.title: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Videos in the Clipchamp Start Page
items.description: Users can use Copilot to create videos directly from the Clipchamp Start page. Turn a simple prompt or existing document into a polished video in minutes. Copilot will automatically draft a script, selects visuals, add narration, and assembles the video for you—no video editing experience required. Review, refine, and export your video quickly, all in one flow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
items.description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a compliant MCP server.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience
items.description: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New room optimization mode user experience in Teams desktop
items.description: Users can more easily use their laptop for meetings and collaboration in spaces like focus or huddle rooms that don’t yet have a Teams Rooms system. The new room optimization mode replaces shared display mode, has a new location, and enables or disables room-specific features. When room peripherals are connected, Teams can automatically select audio and video devices, enable speaker recognition and shared display, and disable voice isolation.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
items.description: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, transcription and agent access to recordings. Recordings are stored in SharePoint and available through the Queues app call history. Note: Queues app requires a Teams Premium license.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting recap app
items.description: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. Quick filters help you surface the right meetings instantly, while audio recap lets you efficiently review multiple meetings at once. You can also browse and revisit any recap from the past 30 days.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
items.description: Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Support human interpreter listening mode in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows now supports human interpreter listening mode in meetings where organizers enable language interpretation in Meeting options, allowing room participants to select a language and hear interpreter audio.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat panel open by default in the gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Town hall media optimization for VDI attendees
items.description:
What’s new
Teams now supports audio and video offloading for Town hall attendees in VDI environments that are using the new optimization. Media streams are offloaded directly to the user’s local device, improving performance and delivering a high definition viewing experience while reducing virtual desktop resource usage.
Who it applies to
•	Windows endpoints only using the new VDI optimization
•	Supported VDI platforms:
o	Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365
o	Citrix
o	Omnissa
o	Amazon WorkSpaces
What stays the same
All attendee interactivity features remain supported, including captions, DV

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel-based desk dock devices
items.description: Users have better experiences in flexible work environments with Microsoft Teams panel-based desk dock devices coming later this year. The Teams panel app now enables devices, such as the Yealink Linkhub, to enhance bookable desk experiences by indicating at-a-glance availability and letting visitors book directly on the device. Each device requires a Teams Shared Space license.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter is disabled by default for captions
items.description: We are updating the default profanity filter setting for live captions from On to Off across Teams meetings, calls, events, and Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) devices to improve accessibility and align with EU requirements. This change will only affect users who have never configured their live captions profanity filter preference. Users who have already set their preference will keep their current setting. As a result, some users may begin seeing unfiltered profanity in live captions by default after this rollout. Users can update this preference in settings at any time.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
items.description: Teams chat and channel lists can be filtered to show unread items only. When this filter is applied, hovering over a section reveals an eye icon next to the section name. Selecting the eye icon opens a list of read chats or channels within that section, allowing you to open them without leaving the unread-only view.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors
items.description: Microsoft is announcing the General Availability (GA) of federated Copilot connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Copilot to popular third‑party sources and retrieve data in real time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). These connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft services; access occurs in real time using the user’s identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 admin center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported in Researcher agent, Microsoft 36

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
items.description: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
items.description: Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Excel files now open in a standardized preview in Teams on Android and iOS, delivering faster performance, improved reliability, and a more consistent viewing experience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: One-stop admin portal for Teams devices with Teams Rooms Pro Management
items.description: Admins now have a one-stop portal for inventory, health monitoring, management, and analytics for both Windows and Android devices with the Pro Management portal. Management of all Android Teams rooms, panels, and phone devices are transitioning to this portal from the Teams admin center, enabling easy, consistent, and secure management of Teams devices across all operating systems and manufacturers.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Meeting Prepare from Up Next
items.description: Get timely reminders in Outlook mobile to prepare for your meetings with Copilot. The Up Next card now offers a Prepare option so you can get ready with one tap.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Slash commands for apps
items.description: You can now interact with your favorite apps directly from Teams chat and channels compose box using slash commands.  Type / and start interacting with Apps and Agents, invoke workflows and more.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
items.description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
items.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live Light theme support
items.description: Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings.

items.title: Planner: Task Details Side Pane experience
items.description: The Task Details Side Pane lets you view and edit task details in a side pane while keeping your Board, Grid, or My Tasks view visible. Update tasks without losing context or switching back and forth from modal dialogs.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Block all identified external bots automatically from joining your meetings
items.description: Extending the admin controls provided for managing external AI bots and regulating their access to your meetings, we are adding the option to automatically block all identified bots.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
items.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
items.description: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.

items.title: SharePoint: Admin Center - detailed report on Everyone except external user permissions
items.description: The new report provides SharePoint Advanced Management admins complete item level details of permissions granted to Everyone except external user and Everyone special SharePoint groups.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Security Detection Report in Teams Admin Center
items.description: A new Security Detection Report in the Teams admin center provides a centralized view of messaging security detections, including impersonation, malicious URLs, and weaponizable file types. Admins can review detection activity in one place and export detailed data to support investigation and response. This capability helps consolidate security signals for Teams messaging scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced cross-platform join via SIP for Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Enable Teams Rooms on Android to join third-party meetings via SIP, delivering seamless cross-platform interoperability. This capability ensures users can connect to external meeting services directly from Teams Rooms, maintaining a consistent and reliable meeting experience across diverse environments. Available on Teams Rooms Pro license.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updates to Memory and Personalization in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Copilot now uses chat history to provide more relevant, contextual responses. Updated settings make it easier to view and manage what Copilot remembers and your personalization preferences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Domain exclusion for web grounding
items.description: This feature will allow admins to specify a limited set of sites to exclude from web grounding in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Places: Microsoft Places Support to GCC cloud
items.description: Microsoft Places features will now be available in GCC cloud

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot
items.description: The Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot expedites answers for the most common workplace policy-related questions and takes action on key HR and IT related tasks, connecting employees to authorized knowledge bases and HR/IT systems of record for faster resolution time and a streamlined employee experience.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Survey Owner role provides access to survey results
items.description: When a new program is being set up in Glint, there is now an option to designate Survey Owners. Those added as Survey Owners will be able to view and manage certain aspects of the program, as well as see the results when a survey in the program closes.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
items.description: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions. Approval requests appear inline in the channel where the agent is deployed, including Microsoft Tea

items.title: Microsoft 365: Organizational Data Service is now available in GCC-High
items.description: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service enables rapid ingestion of organizational/HR data through connectors from multiple HRIS systems using a single unified ingestion point. This service also provides organizational data for use across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps to power various features with robust data quality framework that detects, communicates, and provides solutions for data quality issues before data is used.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the GCC High environment.

items.title: SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
items.description: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center. With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online in the event of classification failure
items.description: Default protection controls for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket policy for all failure conditions.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Enhanced Security Accounts Manager (sAM) Account Name support for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
items.description: Enhanced support for synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) with Microsoft Entra Domain Services is now in Public Preview. This feature allows sAMAccountName to be populated from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Microsoft Entra ID. Existing managed domains can enable the new synchronization behavior, while it is enabled by default for new managed domains. When enabled, existing hybrid users are updated during synchronization; cloud-only users without an onPremisesSamAccountName value continue to use mailNickname-based generation. The feature is avail

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
items.description: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. It normalizes activity from integrated Microsoft security products, including Microsoft Entra sign-ins, Microsoft Graph audit events, SaaS and cloud activity, and device logons. New fields and filters include Source table, Session ID, and Unique token identifier, with expanded Conditional Access and event context.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Entra ID Backup & Recovery
items.description: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point. Advanced recovery features are currently limited to the Entra admin portal, but some user recovery actions will be possible via the M365 Backup native app UX in the M365 Admin center. Note that the existing 7-day recovery that comes with a customer's P1 & P2 licenses is already generally ava

items.title: SharePoint: Site Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: The feature introduces enhanced Site Skills management capabilities, including skill editing, version control, publishing, restoration, and cross-site duplication, enabling organizations to govern and reuse skills more effectively across SharePoint sites.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot admin configuration assistance
items.description: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance. Responses will include deep links to configuration pages streamlining navigation and discoverability. Only available for Viva Glint users with Admin permissions.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Unified Agent and App Installation Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
items.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center will be able to apply app and agent installation changes once and have them consistently enforced across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Previously, installation changes made in the Microsoft 365 admin center only applied to Outlook and Microsoft 365, while changes made in the Teams admin center only applied to Teams. With this update, app and agent installation is unified across all supported surfaces, enabling a more consistent and streamlined admin experience.

items.title: Microsoft Agent 365: the control plane for agents
items.description: Agent 365 is the control plane for AI agents. It empowers IT and security administrators to observe, govern, and secure agents across Microsoft 365 and connected platforms at scale.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Ability to preview content in Insider Risk Management Alerts
items.description:
Insider Risk Management is excited to announce the ability to preview content directly within an IRM alert without having to create a case. Users with appropriate permissions will be able to preview relevant files referenced directly within activity explorer in each alert.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational require

items.title: Universal Print: audit logging
items.description: I can access Universal Print audit records of key administrator and user activities, such as print job submissions, configuration changes, and printer registrations. Audit records will be available in Microsoft Purview’s Unified Audit Log for compliance and long-term record-keeping.

items.title: Universal Print: Logs and alerts
items.description: With a new Azure Monitor integration, Universal Print customers can send detailed diagnostic logs to a Log Analytics workspace to conduct troubleshooting and configure custom alerts.

items.title: Outlook: Offline settings "Days of email to save" admin policy
items.description: Tenant admins will be able to define the default value for "Days of email to save" in Offline settings and designate whether end users can change the setting. This policy will set and enforce the "Days of email to save" setting found under Settings > General > Offline. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Now smarter with visuals: Copilot Chat leverages embedded images for richer, more accurate answers.
items.description: Copilot has been enhanced to interpret and ground responses using images embedded in files such as Word documents (.docx), PowerPoint presentations (.pptx), and PDFs. This capability allows Copilot to extract insights from visual elements like charts, diagrams, and screenshots, ensuring that answers are not only text-based but also informed by graphical context. By combining textual and visual understanding, Copilot delivers more comprehensive and contextually accurate responses for complex queries

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Adaptive Scopes for DLP for SharePoint
items.description: Adaptive Scope for SharePoint is a dynamic scoping capability in Microsoft Purview DLP that allows administrators to automatically target DLP policies to the right sites based on attributes such as site URL, site name, or custom site metadata. Unlike static scoping, which requires manually listing sites and maintaining them over time, adaptive scopes continuously evaluate site properties and auto‑include or exclude locations as they evolve. This enables scalable policy deployment, eliminates the 100‑site static policy limit, and delivers granular, and automated targeting.

items.title: Planner: Track task progress with the Completion (%) field
items.description: The new Completion (%) column in Microsoft Planner provides a more precise view of task progress. Users can view and update completion as a percentage, helping teams communicate incremental progress and quickly understand how far work has advanced.

items.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
items.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
items.description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.

items.title: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
items.description: Users will now have basic options for printing calendar events in #newoutlookforwindows and Teams calendar, including choosing whether to show all attendees or display a shortened list of up to 10 attendees via a checkbox.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
items.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment. Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Full Submissions experience in GCC
items.description: This is item is no longer accurate and we are removing it from the roadmap, we apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Outlook: Automatically display auto-mapped calendars
items.description: Users will be able to automatically see their auto-mapped calendars when toggling from classic Outlook to the new. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Planner: Connected Plans
items.description: Connected Plans let teams link related plans together to organize work across projects and initiatives. Navigate between connected plans and make related work easier to find and manage.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Open message links in new window
items.description: Teams now enables links within chat and channel messages to open in a new window, so you can compare information side by side without losing the context of your ongoing conversation. Access this capability through the More options menu or by using Ctrl/Cmd + click.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
items.description: Policy updates in Microsoft Purview now sync faster, reducing wait times from up to 2 hours to just 30 minutes, so your protections stay up to date and take effect more quickly across your organization.

items.title: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year options for email sync window (Offline settings)
items.description: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access. This expands the existing offline settings and allows users to access more email when they are not connected to the internet. The new options are available under Settings > General > Offline > Days of email to save, giving users greater flexibility based on their storage and offline needs."

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Newly created Declarative Agents now understand referenced scanned PDFs
items.description: Any newly created Declarative Agents can now reliably ground answers in scanned PDFs and image-based documents referenced from SharePoint, unlocking a major class of enterprise content that was previously hard to use in agent scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Tip Support in Outlook for Mac
items.description: DLP policy tips for Microsoft Outlook for Mac provide real-time notifications to users when their email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can see policy tips directly in the mail tip UI and have the option to remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy if necessary. This feature ensures compliance by alerting users to potential data loss risks before sending emails.

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook Mobile
items.description: DLP policy tip support for Outlook Mobile enhances data loss prevention measures on mobile devices by providing real-time alerts to help users avoid accidentally sharing sensitive information, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook mobile apps
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on mobile devices.

items.title: Outlook: Manage Multiple Inbox Rules at Once
items.description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. You can then delete, enable, or disable the selected rules in one action. This makes it faster and easier to keep your rules organized. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills- removal and deletion admin control
items.description:
A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant. With this new control, organizations can delete their entire skills library along with all users confirmed, inferred, and imported skills data—giving them full control to offboard from People Skills in support of data governance and compliance needs.
Once deletion is initiated, skills will no longer appear on user profile cards or be used across Microsoft 365 skills-based experiences such as Copilot and Viva. The control is admin-only with no automat

items.title: Planner: Custom Templates
items.description: Custom templates let you create reusable, pre-designed layouts tailored to your organization’s needs, ensuring consistency and saving time. They provide flexibility to standardize content while allowing easy customization for specific scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices
items.description: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 admin center – New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report for GCC High & DoD
items.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report will include total enabled and active users, Copilot usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs – Unified REST Endpoint for Agents and Workflows
items.description: Introduces a new REST endpoint for Work IQ that serves as a unified entry point for invoking agents and workflows, providing a consistent, scalable alternative to legacy Copilot Chat endpoints.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
items.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – Enhanced multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options
items.description: Viva Glint administrators will be able to create multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options and upload options using a CSV file. For questions containing more than 50 options, survey takers can search and filter the available responses, making longer lists faster and easier to navigate. Reporting will support the expanded option set.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – In-product access to feature announcements
items.description: Viva Glint service administrators will see a new announcement icon in the product header that links directly to the Viva Glint Tech Community blog. This makes it easier to discover product news, feature announcements, and best practices.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot
items.description: M365 Copilot now supports Writing blocks. Edit drafts, memos, emails, and more inline while using Chat for easy editing and iteration.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
items.description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Import Google account data anytime from Settings
items.description: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage. Users can hide the room self-preview video and choose to see audio and video participants equally on stage, instead of prioritizing video participants. Admins can choose the default behavior using local device settings and the Pro Management portal.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: The Interpreter agent acts as a translator in Microsoft Teams meetings, allowing participants to listen to the meeting in their chosen language with real-time translation so speaking different languages isn’t a barrier to effective understanding and collaboration. It's now available in Teams Rooms on Android licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Improvements to agent evaluations experience
items.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio is enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior. New capabilities include richer evaluation explanations, agent reasoning traces, cited knowledge sources, evaluation run comparison, support for larger datasets, customizable test generation, and dataset generation from knowledge sources. These improvements help makers identify quality issues more quickly, understand why evaluations succeed or fail, compare results across runs, and create higher quality evaluation datasets with less manual effort. Additional validation

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Code Blocks in M365 Copilot
items.description: M365 Copilot now supports code blocks, which lets you preview code, charts, diagrams, and more directly inline while using Chat. Previously, users could preview code side-by-side in a code canvas.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Emoji shortcuts with autocomplete on mobile
items.description: Teams brings desktop-style emoji shortcuts to mobile (iOS and Android), allowing you to insert emojis by typing colon-based commands like :smile:. Real-time autocomplete suggestions help you quickly find the right emoji as you type, while support for custom emojis enables more personalized and expressive communication on the go.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
items.description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications in case of any data loss incident that may occur due to a misconfigured policy or regression. Prior

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs - Endpoints: Declarative Agent Access
items.description: Enables programmatic access to first‑party and tenant‑defined declarative agents via the Work IQ endpoint, allowing applications to trigger specialized agents for domain‑specific tasks within broader workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved visibility and control for downloads
items.description: Download manager updates in Microsoft Teams make it easier to track file progress with improved visibility, control, and accessibility. You can now open the manager from the title bar or by using a keyboard shortcut, and view downloads without blocking key chat and channel actions.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent in Data Loss Prevention - Reasoning Trace and Confidence Score for agent-triaged alerts
items.description: This feature introduces confidence scoring and reasoning trace explainability into the Data Security Triage Agent in DLP, addressing a critical trust gap reported across multiple customers. Today, without transparency into why the agent makes a decision or how confident it is, analysts are forced to fall back to manual review — completely negating the automation value. The feature will surface a reasoning trace alongside each agent decision and a confidence score, giving analysts a clear signal of how reliable the agent's output is. This provides SOC teams with an auditable, explainable output

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
items.description: You can now reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Enhancements to the room booking experience in the Places app
items.description: We’re enhancing the room booking experience in the Places App to align with the desk booking flow and visuals. This unifies the booking experience across rooms and desks.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated UI for Copilot Chat entry point in Word, Excel and PowerPoint apps
items.description: We are updating the entry point user interface for Copilot Chat. The Copilot Chat entry point button will move out of the app ribbon to the app canvas to help with discoverability and use within the context of the file. This update will apply to Microsoft 365 users of Word, Excel and PowerPoint who are eligible for Copilot Chat across web, mobile and desktop.

items.title: Planner: Available in Outlook
items.description: Planner in Outlook brings all your tasks, plans, and the new Planner Agent directly into your inbox, so you can manage work where you already work.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook for Mac
items.description: DLP policy tips for Microsoft Outlook for Mac provide real-time notifications to users when their email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can see policy tips directly in the mail tip UI and have the option to remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy if necessary. This feature ensures compliance by alerting users to potential data loss risks before sending emails.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Assistant field visibility in Organization view
items.description: Teams now displays assistant information in the Organization view on the profile card and in the Org Explorer, making it easier to identify a key support contact for executive coordination and scheduling. This designation is informational only and does not grant permissions, change roles, or affect organizational hierarchy.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds
items.description: Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widgets when interacting with agents that implement them, and admins will continue to manage these agents through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot chat summary
items.description: Missed many messages? Copilot will automatically generate a summary of the new messages in a chat conversation, so you can catch up quickly without reading every message.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Long-term retention period for M365 Backup
items.description: This creates the ability to set longer term retention periods to restore beyond one year.

items.title: Outlook: Change the organizer of a meeting
items.description: Transfer ownership of a meeting or recurring meeting series to another person in your organization. The new organizer must accept the transfer before it is completed. This helps maintain continuity for long-running meetings while preserving the existing event for attendees. Available in Outlook for Windows and web and Teams calendar.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- Select user-owned SharePoint embedded container as a data source
items.description: eDiscovery users will be able to view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned or created by a selected person. These containers store content from apps such as Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks.

items.title: OneDrive: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
items.description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in Teams meetings and events
items.description: A new meeting option for Teams meetings with presenters and events that enables organizers to designate 'Who has control of production tools' during the event. Users defined here will have access to the controls in 'Manage What Attendees See' and the ‘Green Room'.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
items.description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Data – Granular access policy controls for custom attributes
items.description: We are introducing enhanced access policy management for Organizational Data in Microsoft 365. This update enables admins to release custom attributes to specific users or groups, rather than broadly to all employees or all managers. This provides a more conservative default approach for managing sensitive organizational data, while also supporting staged rollout of new attributes. Additionally, admins can configure whether leaders and managers are permitted to share non-public data with Workforce Insights delegates. This enhancement improves governance, flexibility, and control over organizat

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
items.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the fuller, workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint thumbnail previews
items.description: Microsoft Teams on desktop now shows rich link previews when you share SharePoint pages. Links automatically expand into a visually appealing card with a thumbnail image and page description, making it easier to understand and engage with shared SharePoint content directly in Teams.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
items.description: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Quarantine Action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
items.description: File Quarantine action in Microsoft Purview DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive, enables stronger, immediate protection for sensitive data. When a DLP policy is triggered, the File Quarantine action automatically moves the file to a restricted, admin‑controlled & defined quarantine location—instantly removing access for all users while preserving the file for review and investigation. This capability helps organizations contain data‑exposure risks, prevents further sharing or misuse, and delivers a powerful new layer of enforcement.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
items.description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Decoupling of Policy tips and Email notifications while configuring rules on Data Loss Prevention for Sharepoint and Onedrive
items.description: As of today, whenever the user wants to enable email notifications the policy tips also need to be enabled and vice versa, but with this decoupling the admin can configure the following: 1) None of policy tips or email notification 2) Only policy tips 3) Only Email Notifications 4) Both Email Notifications and Policy tips

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports (U.S. Government clouds)
items.description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports
items.description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis. Note: The status and release month has been updated to reflect the current state. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Expand presenter visibility in 'Manage what attendees see' for Teams events
items.description: Users will now be able to resize and expand the presenter panel in 'Manage what attendees see' options for Teams events. This feature helps make it easier to view, manage, and switch between presenters during events.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - Advanced Review Set Explorer
items.description: The Advanced Review Set Explorer empowers reviewers to harness the power of real-time big data analytics on their review set data. This tool enhances data analysis by offering insights such as identifying top item types, spotting patterns, and trends within the review set. Reviewers can utilize powerful Kusto query constructs like complex filtering, pattern-based text extraction, and data format parsing to analyze and find key information specific to their case or organization. The results can then be visualized using various flexible charting solutions, providing a comprehensive understanding

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Actionable Email Notifications for Enhanced Incident Remediation
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention end-user email notification is getting advanced incident remediation capabilities: actionable email notifications. This new feature allows end users to take remediation actions directly from their mailbox, streamlining the remediation process. The end users will be able take remediation actions on files on OneDrive and SharePoint that caused a policy match. Key actions now available in our email notifications include - stop sharing file, delete file, apply label, override the policy, report false positive and unable to take action.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: eDiscovery - Advanced Review Set Explorer
items.description: The Advanced Review Set Explorer empowers reviewers to harness the power of real-time big data analytics on their review set data leveraging. This tool enhances data analysis by offering insights such as identifying top item types, spotting patterns, and trends within the review set. items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention end-user email notification is getting advanced incident remediation capabilities: actionable email notifications. This new feature allows end users to take remediation actions directly from their mailbox, streamlining the remediation process. The end users will be able take remediation actions on files on OneDrive and SharePoint that caused a policy match. items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Granular classification error controls (Exchange online)
items.description: Granular Protections for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket policy for all failure conditions.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Vertical Tabs update
items.description: Microsoft Edge is updating its vertical tab implementation and architecture. Edge is reimplementing capabilities across pane, layout, controls, tab behavior, visual treatments, & embedder customizations. No admin action is required.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
items.description:
We are improving the live captions experience in Microsoft Teams with new viewing layouts and streamlined configuration options. Users can now view live captions in a new right-side panel, in addition to the existing options of viewing them at the top or bottom of the screen, or popping them out into a separate window.
We are also making it easier to manage caption settings directly within the meeting. By clicking the existing gear icon in the live captions pane, users will see a consolidated menu to quickly configure spoken language, caption styles, and profanity filters without navigating to

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual recap available with translation button
items.description: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.

items.title: Outlook: Jump to Any Folder Instantly with Go to Folder
items.description: You can now quickly search for and navigate to any folder in your mailbox using the new Go to Folder feature. Instead of scrolling through long folder lists, just press Ctrl+Y or access it from your accounts context menu to instantly find what you need. Type a few letters of the folder name and jump straight there. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
items.description: Admin should be able to see the Endpoint DLP policy sync status on the Purview portal within 30 mins.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Android console
items.description: With Teams Rooms on Android consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
items.description: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.

items.title: OneNote: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (DoD, GCC, GCC High)
items.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for DoD, GCC, and GCC High clouds now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform Single Sign-on can now be used as a second factor for MFA
items.description: Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) and macOS Platform SSO (macOS PSSO) can now satisfy multifactor authentication as a standalone second factor. Previously, these methods only counted as MFA during primary sign-in, and users needed a separate passkey to complete step-up prompts, Authentication Strength policies, and sign-in frequency checks. With this change, WHfB and macOS PSSO work on their own for those scenarios, so more of your users can rely on strong, phishing-resistant sign-in without registering an extra method. What you need to know: Users who have only WHfB or macOS PSSO are now trea

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection available for DoD environments
items.description: Shared display mode in Teams is now available in government DOD environments, enabling more seamless and private meeting hosting from your PC. Additionally, peripheral detection for bring-your-own-device spaces is available for inventory management and reporting through the Pro Management portal.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app for Microsoft Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: We’re excited to announce that the Queues app is now available in the GCC High and DoD clouds. This Teams-native app helps organizations manage customer engagements more efficiently by bringing advanced call queue and auto attendant capabilities directly into Teams. Queues app is a Teams Premium feature. For more information about Queues app, including licensing information, please see Manage Queues app for Microsoft Teams in your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Count of Labelled Documents Condition
items.description: This release introduces a new condition for Exchange Online policies: “Count of labeled documents is greater than.”  This condition evaluates the number of attachments in an email message that carry a matching sensitivity label. When the count exceeds a defined threshold, the DLP rule is triggered, and configured actions are applied. This capability enables detection of high-volume data exfiltration scenarios, where multiple sensitive files—individually low-risk—collectively represent a significant compliance or security risk. Existing conditions evaluate file content, but do not provide contr

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Reusable Global List for Exchange Online
items.description: Reusable Lists centralize management of keywords, domains, and email addresses, eliminating duplication across rules and reducing the effort required to maintain large policies.

items.title: Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks
items.description:
Meetings as References in Copilot Notebooks bring Teams meeting content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot on the discussions, decisions, and context that drive their work. By adding meetings as knowledge sources, users can connect transcripts, notes, chats, and shared content directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. 

Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Efficiency Mode
items.description: Teams efficiency mode improves performance and responsiveness on hardware constrained devices by applying a reduced resource configuration by default, helping maintain meeting quality and responsiveness during collaboration.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Test your microphone before you join
items.description: Before joining a meeting on your pre-join screen, you can test your microphone and speaker to make sure others will hear you clearly. Select Test mic and speaker to record a short audio clip and play it back. This helps you confirm that the right devices are selected and that you’ll be heard—and hear others—once the meeting starts.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Room health signals and notifications in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: When critical issues impact room functionality, users see a banner notification on both the front-of-room display and console in Teams Rooms on Windows.  Room health signals help get issues resolved quickly and ensure productive meetings. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agents usage report
items.description: A new agents usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center. The report will be scoped to include agents in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat with usage by both M365 Copilot licensed and unlicensed users. The report will include total active agent users, total active agents, active users segmentation by licensed and unlicensed users, and active users and active agents segmentation by publisher type (i.e. user-created agents, agents built by your org, agents built by Microsoft, agents built by Microsoft partners). The report will also include usage details per user, agent, and use

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Dataverse integration on Copilot Studio
items.description: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data. This enhancement allows organizations to leverage business-critical information stored in Dataverse—including records, customer data, operational data, and business application content—as a trusted knowledge source for agent experiences.

items.title: OneDrive: New Shortcuts folder option when adding shortcuts
items.description: OneDrive makes it easy to add shortcuts to the files and folders you use most. Now you can choose to keep those shortcuts neatly together in one place instead of mixed in with everything else. When you add a shortcut, you can send it to a dedicated "Shortcuts" folder rather than your OneDrive root.
