items.description: Compare Copilot active usage with benchmarks in Copilot Dashboard. External benchmarks will provide a reference for how usage compares to other companies. Internal benchmarks will enable users to compare similar groups, within your company. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance center: Insider Risk Management - Policy scoping enhancements
items.description: After further review, we continue rolling this out. We apologize for any inconvenience. With this release, Insider Risk Management administrators can include or exclude specific users, groups, and adaptive scopes within policies. We are also adding support for non-mail enabled Security Groups within IRM policies. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies,

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - User analytics
items.description:
With this feature, insights will be generated for potentially risky behaviors at a user level and will be surfaced across the following experiences:

1) Insider risk management context in DLP alert investigation
2) Insider risk management context in Communication compliance alert investigation
3) Insider risk management context in Microsoft Defender XDR user entity page
4) Advanced hunting in Microsoft Defender XDR  

User analytics will cover all eligible users in the tenant including users not in the scope of any Insider risk management policy. Customers can enable/disable user analytics in

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - User exclusion
items.description: After further review, we continue rolling this out. We apologize for any inconvenience. This introduces the ability to exclude users and groups from IRM policies. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Custom user mapping for SuccessFactors integration
items.description: Admins can now specify the user mapping attributes in the LMS setup form.

items.title: Outlook: Read-only access to contacts within a PST file in new Outlook for Windows
items.description: With this update of support for .pst files (a.k.a. Outlook Data File) in the new Outlook for Windows, users will be able to browse and read contacts within a .pst file. Future releases of new Outlook will expand the support for .pst file capabilities. #newoutlookforwindows #pstfilesupport.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Customers can connect M365 Copilot with Dropbox to access and manage cloud files with Copilot Connector
items.description: Customers can connect M365 Copilot with Dropbox to access and manage cloud files with Copilot Connector.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Open Teams' apps in new window
items.description: Organize your work environment to fit your needs. Users can open Teams' apps, like Chat, Calls, Activity and more in separate windows, allowing users to view and interact with these apps simultaneously.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Sync provider data from a specific date range
items.description: We are introducing flexibility on provider setup form where admins can sync data from specific dates for a provider instead of full data sync.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Customer Facing Reports via Insights Integration
items.description: Org level breakdown of Learning metrics in Viva Insights.

items.title: OneDrive: Agents in OneDrive
items.description: Find yourself referencing the same files using Copilot in OneDrive? We are bringing the power of agents to OneDrive, allowing you to build, use, and share your own agents using files and content stored in your OneDrive. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to customers on OneDrive Web.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Enhanced Classification Support for Thai language in Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
items.description: In our continued efforts to enhance classification capabilities, we have added a new feature, Word-Breaker, to our existing Thai Language support in Classification. Words in Thai language sentences do not have spaces between them. And for classification purpose, we relied on the right keywords to be added while creating Sensitive Information Type for ensuring accurate match. However, with this feature, spaces will be added automatically in keywords which will ensure higher match accuracy across all cloud locations (Exchange, Teams, One Drive, SharePoint).

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Enhanced Classification Support for Thai Language in Endpoint
items.description: Thai Language sentences do not have spaces in between them. And for classification purpose, we relied on right keywords to be added while creating Sensitive Information Type for ensuring accurate match. However, with this feature, spaces will be added automatically in keywords which will ensure higher match accuracy in EndPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: 1080P Resolution in Teams Town Halls
items.description: Teams town hall will soon bring 1080P resolution to Teams town hall. This enhancement brings a sharper appearance with more visual clarity to videos, images, and other visual assets within your online events. This feature is available for town halls created by organizers with a Teams Premium license.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Open channels in a new window
items.description: You can now open channels in a separate window to stay on top of multiple conversations at once.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can help manage tasks and create documents
items.description: Facilitator can help users manage tasks and create documents during meetings. In addition to the tasks that the agent is automatically capturing during the meeting, users can ask Facilitator directly through the meeting chat to create, edit, and assign tasks, which sync to Planner. For tasks related to document creation, users can assign to Facilitator and it will draft the document based on the meeting discussion. Users can also ask the agent to create a draft document on a topic discussed in the meeting.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Risky AI usage
items.description:
With this update, Insider Risk Management will help admins identify risky AI usage. We are adding new detections of intentional and unintentional insider risk activity on generative AI apps that can pose a risk to an organization. Activities will include risky prompts containing sensitive info or risky intent and sensitive responses containing sensitive info or is generated from sensitive files or sites.  Coverage will span across Microsoft Copilots and 3P generative AI apps. These detections will also contribute to Adaptive Protection insider risk levels.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Manag

items.title: Planner: Support for Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) content sensitivity labels
items.description: Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) content sensitivity label support in Planner will enable encryption, restrict unauthorised actions such as copying, printing, or exporting plan contents, and add visual markings like watermarks for clear sensitivity awareness. By enforcing content-level protections, Planner will help organisations prevent data leaks, maintain compliance, and enable secure collaboration without affecting productivity.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing new AI analysis capabilities
items.description: Data Security Investigations (DSI) now features advanced AI analysis tools, including options to add investigative context for higher-quality results, as well as improvements in vector search relevance and content categorization to better identify risky material. Additionally, we've launched a new AI-powered search function that lets investigators use natural language to locate specific files by searching through keywords, metadata, and embeddings.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introduction of both in-product cost estimator and transparency report
items.description: Introducing a Data Security Investigations (DSI) lightweight cost estimator designed to help analysts model and forecast both storage and compute unit costs based on specific use cases, enabling more accurate budget planning. In addition to the estimator, a new report provides granular breakdowns of billed storage and compute unit usage, empowering DSI analysts to identify cost-saving opportunities and optimize resource allocation.

items.title: Excel: Formula completion with Copilot in Excel
items.description: This feature leverages AI to autocomplete the user's formula upon typing the '=' sign. It provides context-based suggestions, streamlining the formula creation process by offering intelligent and relevant completions.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Apply partial settings for Android devices using configuration profiles in the Teams admin center
items.description: In the Teams admin center, admins can now modify, review, and apply configuration settings to Android devices without overriding other settings ensuring only the desired changes are made.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Microsoft 365 Backup capabilities available in GCC
items.description: We are bringing Microsoft 365 Backup Service capabilities to GCC. Microsoft 365 Backup is a product offering spanning across the OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online services that provides customers with a consistent, cross product solution, to recover their M365 data from cataclysmic events such as: at scale ransomware attacks, or malicious/accidental data deletion/corruption by end users.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Ability to view inferred skills and course recommendations
items.description: Learners would be able to select skills for learning, view inferred skills and courses recommendations based on inferred skills. Inferred skills are generated by taking users activity in M365 ecosystem into account.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Detailed error description for SuccessFactors sync failures
items.description: Sync failure details pop-up will now have detailed error description and next steps.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Ingestion logs in Viva Learning for SAP SuccessFactors
items.description: This creates LMS ingestion logs for sync summary, user sync, and LRS data. Logs will help admins debug any ingestion-related issues.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft365): Graph API - Copilot for Microsoft 365 usage
items.description: Copilot for Microsoft 365 usage will be added to the Microsoft Graph API, allowing for the creation of customized reporting and analytics. Metrics included in the Graph API will match those available in the Copilot for Microsoft 365 usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center, including tenant-level count of enabled users and active users, as well as last activity date per user (all up and per Microsoft 365 app). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft 365: New map-based room booking experience in Places Finder
items.description: We are enhancing the room booking experience in the new calendar experience across Outlook for Windows, Outlook for the web, and Teams by introducing a map view within Places Finder. This update replaces the existing side panel with a full screen, easier to use interface that helps people quickly find and book the right space.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic removal of EXIF data from shared images
items.description: Teams will automatically remove hidden metadata (EXIF) from images shared in conversations. This privacy protection helps prevent sensitive information such as photo location and device details from being shared without your knowledge.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification strings for recording and transcription
items.description: IT admins can customize the message and privacy link used to notify implicitly or gain explicit consent from meeting participants for the use of recording, transcription during the meeting.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Town Hall and Webinar in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Windows is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. Presenters always have full control from the console, including green room and off-stage management, and can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Excel: Post-migration Excel remediation
items.description: Enable the remediation of incompatible formulas and file links in formulas in Excel files after migration from other cloud platforms to Microsoft 365.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Customize M365 Copilot for your organization with Copilot Tuning
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Tuning is introducing new templates in Agent Builder, designed for tasks such as drafting complex documents, validating documents against guidelines, and editing to match a distinct writing style.  Users with Copilot Tuning enabled can further customize the template-based agents by tuning the context, tools, and underlying models with their organization’s proprietary data, processes, and standards. This empowers your teams with customized agents aligned to how your organization works.

items.title: PowerPoint: Designer is now part of Copilot, enhanced with new template and slide Suggestions.
items.description: Designer is now part of Copilot. Copilot Suggestions now brings you familiar Designer slide layout and presentation template suggestions in a vertical gallery, along with new capabilities.

items.title: Microsoft Intune: macOS Custom Compliance
items.description: This feature will enable users to use discovery script and json file to define compliance policy to specific organziational needs. The experience mirrors Windows and Linux custom compliance experience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP - Enhanced content extraction and file type coverage for DLP on Mac devices
items.description: With this release, the file type coverage to scan, classify and protect sensitive content on Mac devices with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policies will increase from current ~40 file types to 100+ file types.This release will make the coverage of file types on endpoint consistent with other locations such as Exchange, SharePoint and OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Troubleshoot meetings and calls with automatic issue identification and recommendations
items.description: Administrators can troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls in Teams admin center with ease with a streamlined flow, meeting quality issues, and detailed telemetry.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Emojis in Section Names
items.description: Choose an emoji to accompany section names in your chats and channels list.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams client health dashboards in Teams Admin Center
items.description: IT Administrators can view and monitor the health of Teams desktop clients on both Windows and Mac platforms. This feature offers comprehensive admin actionable insights into client health metrics, including client crashes and launch failures. Administrators are equipped with detailed information on issues, insights, and mitigation tools to promptly and effectively address any potential client health problems.

items.title: Outlook: Updated Copilot Button for Android
items.description: We are updating the UI for Copilot Chat so that the button is separate from the mail and event compose buttons. This feature will be available for users with a Copilot license.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Highlights on Copilot adoption from Viva Engage
items.description: Explore how Copilot is making a difference in your organization through Viva Engage posts that users have shared. The Copilot Dashboard showcases real-world success stories, user-shared excitement about new Copilot features, and vibrant community discussions. These examples offer a qualitative view into how Copilot is driving productivity and engagement across your tenant, directly in the Copilot Dashboard. #CopilotControlSystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Auto-Archive for Exchange Online
items.description: A new capability called Auto-Archiving for Exchange Online will enter public preview in November 2025 (currently under private preview for selected customers). When a user's mailbox utilization exceeds 95% of its quota and archive mailbox is present, this feature automatically moves the oldest items excluding those tagged with “Never Move to Archive” from the primary mailbox to the archive mailbox to prevent mail flow disruptions by keeping usage below the safe threshold of 95% of mailbox quota.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): In Copilot Pages, the Chat can now be used to modify the Page
items.description: When a Chat and a Page are open side by side, prompts within the Chat can now be used to modify or add to the contents of the Page.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Tenant Restrictions v2 (TRv2)
items.description: New enforcement to block access from unauthorized Microsoft 365 tenants directly in Microsoft Edge for Business, helping organizations maintain strict compliance and prevent data leakage across tenant boundaries.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Email attachment Preview in Activity Explorer
items.description: We're enhancing Activity Explorer to provide greater visibility into sensitive data flagged in Exchange Online. Previously, only the message body was viewable, which limited insight into flagged content. With this update, admins will be able to preview email attachments directly within Activity Explorer—without needing to download the email.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - New WebGL software backend
items.description: Microsoft Edge, on Windows systems without a physical GPU, will use the Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform (WARP) rasterizer for WebGL workloads. Prior versions use SwiftShader. This scenario is most common associated with headless environments and virtual machines. On non-Windows platforms, a physical GPU will be required for WebGL moving forward.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Update storyline cover photos in Teams for iOS.
items.description: Users will be able to update their storyline cover photo from Teams for iOS. This is already currently supported on Teams for Android or Windows, Mac, on the web.

items.title: Outlook: Outlook for Android supports PDF attachment preview
items.description: Users can now preview PDFs directly in the Outlook for Android app.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Improved Autofill experience in Microsoft Edge
items.description: When users fill in an Address on a form, they will be prompted to choose whether to save it for future Autofill suggestions. This enhancement ensures Autofill data is saved intentionally by users and reduces unwanted entries as part of their Autofill suggestion.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Content Explorer – Enhanced Tag (SIT, Labels) Filter at UI Layer
items.description: Introduces enhanced controls in Content Explorer’s UI, enabling scoped visibility and filtering of SIT and label data. This will help with content discoverability and governance.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Introduction of secure workflow to bypass retention holds and delete Teams transcripts and/or Teams recordings
items.description: Introducing a capability to Purview compliance admins via a Data Lifecycle Management to bypass retention hold or legal holds to delete content on OneDrive or SharePoint Online such as Teams meeting transcripts and/or recordings earlier than the hold durations to comply with emerging compliance requirements. Leveraging Simulation, authoring approvals, Audit and disposition reviews to set-up and enforce defensible policies.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Focus Area simplification and enhancements
items.description: Beginning with this feature release, Focus Areas will be associated with survey cycles and goal periods will be retired. Users will be able to select the same Focus Area across multiple cycles. The Focus Area Overview report will be filterable to groups of interest (e.g. managers only). Draft/deleted Focus Areas will no longer be included in Focus Area calculations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection - Admin unit scoping in Content Explorer and Data Explorer
items.description: This feature introduces Admin Unit scoping to both Content Explorer and Data Explorer, enabling more granular visibility and control over M365 data. It ensures that data exploration respects organizational boundaries defined by Admin Units, enhancing compliance and governance.

items.title: SharePoint: Permissions report for a given user - SharePoint admin center
items.description: This report, under Data access governance within SharePoint admin center, provides SharePoint admin with a list of sites where the given user has direct and indirect permissions at a site/lib/folder/file level

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Migration Tool for Teams
items.description: Customers will now be able to migrate content seamlessly from Slack public and private channels to Teams shared, public, and private channels. A new first-party migration tool in the Microsoft Admin Center (MAC) will allow admins to review which Slack channels they wish to migrate, then perform content migration to Teams.

items.title: Outlook: People Hub improvements in new Outlook for Windows
items.description: In new Outlook for Windows, the People Hub offers a streamlined contacts interface with a single view of each person, automatically linking duplicates and enriching them with organizational profiles. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention- Source context based file protection for Endpoint
items.description: Protect file based on the website the file is downloaded or the app the file is created.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can now answer questions about opened Copilot Pages in chat
items.description: When using Copilot Pages side-by-side in Copilot Chat, you can now ask questions in chat about your open page, and Copilot will provide answers based on the contents of that page.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention- Logged-in user details on the Purview device onboarding page
items.description: This update introduces logged-in user details (user email) on the device onboarding page for Windows devices bringing it in line with the experience for MacOS devices. ​Admins can now see which user is currently signed in on a device, making It faster to confirm ownership and troubleshoot issues.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Export Executive Summary report in Viva Glint to editable PowerPoint slides
items.description: Managers will be able to export the default sections from the Executive Summary report in Viva Glint directly to editable PowerPoint slides. This enhancement allows for easier and quicker consumption of this report outside Viva Glint, compared to the previous export method which included static screenshots.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Custom permissions UI enhancements in Microsoft Purview Information Protection File Labeler
items.description: This feature borrows the familiar custom permissions menu in Office and replaces the existing custom permissions UI in the Microsoft Purview Information Protection File Labeler. The new menu enables viewer, restricted editor, editor and owner permissions to be assigned to multiple groups at the same time.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Inline protection, alerting, and incident management for sensitive data shared over the network through non-Microsoft SASE integrations
items.description: Extend Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies and Insider Risk Management indicators to the network by integrating with your existing non-Microsoft Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solution. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect traffic inline at the network layer and enforce actions based on DLP policy conditions. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, apps, APIs, add-ins, and more - including generative AI platforms, cloud storage, and content-sharing services - while managing alerts and

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Enhancements to variant limits and detection groups
items.description:
Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management variant limit is being increased from 3 to 10 per indicator and an overall limit of 100 across all indicators. Along with this, the number of items in one detection group is being increased from 200 to 500.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Steer your presentation length, tone, style, and images when creating with Copilot.
items.description: You can now adjust the length of your presentation, the tone of your narrative, the style of your slides, and leverage AI-generated images when creating with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Data source specific filters
items.description: We are introducing a dynamic filtering experience in Microsoft 365 Copilot search that empowers users to refine their results more precisely by leveraging data source-specific filters in the right rail. When a user selects a data source from the right rail, such as Outlook, SharePoint, Jira, or Copilot Chats, the interface dynamically presents a tailored set of filters specific to that source. These refiners allow users to narrow down results based on attributes unique to the selected data source, such as item type, status, or semantic labels.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing on content with sensitivity labels
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extended to Microsoft 365 Copilot. This feature will allow DLP policies to provide detection of sensitivity labels in enterprise  grounding data and restrict access of the content in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Steer your presentation length, tone, style, and images when creating with Copilot.
items.description: You can now adjust the length of your presentation, the tone of your narrative, the style of your slides, and leverage AI-generated images when creating with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Steer your presentation length, tone, style, and images when creating with Copilot.
items.description: You can now adjust the length of your presentation, the tone of your narrative, the style of your slides, and leverage AI-generated images when creating with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Agent-Level Controls for Pay-as-you-go
items.description: This feature introduces admin controls for managing AI agents on a consumption basis within Microsoft 365 Copilot. Administrators can specify which users can access particular agents through pay-as-you-go, control which agents are available for metered consumption, and establish billing policy for each agent. Initially focusing on declarative agents in M365 Copilot Chat and SharePoint, this enhancement enables organizations to effectively manage AI consumption costs and scale intelligent capabilities according to business needs. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: SharePoint: Copilot actions in SharePoint document libraries
items.description: When you select an item in OneDrive on the Web, the Copilot button appears, offering a range of actions you can perform on that item. The same feature and actions are coming to document library views in SharePoint and Teams.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Catch up on a summary of document comments in the top of your document
items.description: Copilot will have a Discussion tab in the top of your document to summarize open comments, helping you quickly understand what people have said in comments.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Data Security Investigation integration
items.description: Launch a pre-scoped Data Security Investigation (DSI) from an IRM case. When a data security admin identifies a risky user who needs deeper investigation, they can launch a pre-scoped investigation directly from an IRM case, allowing them to view content analysis related to that user and better assess post-incident data impact.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Discovery of sensitive data sharing to any cloud application or website (inc. GenAI) via network layer
items.description:
With this update, IRM will support the discovery of sensitive files and text shared to any cloud application or website (inc. GenAI) via network layer. This capability is based on integration with 3rd party network partners (with data being captured via network layer).

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirement

items.title: Microsoft Entra: ID Account Recovery
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID Account Recovery is an advanced authentication recovery mechanism that enables users to regain access to their organizational accounts when they've lost access to all registered authentication methods. Unlike traditional password reset capabilities, account recovery focuses on identity verification and trust re-establishment prior to replacement of authentication methods rather than simple credential recovery.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Protected Clipboard
items.description: Admins shouldn’t have to choose between locking down copy/paste and risking data leaks. Protected Clipboard offers a smarter way for keeping sensitive data safe without disrupting user workflows. Leveraging Purview DLP policies to define trusted boundaries across managed cloud apps. Data inside those admin defined boundaries can stay protected while external data can enter if needed. Granular control for admins. Seamless productivity for users.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Copilot icon visibility
items.description: Users can now manage the Copilot icon in their toolbar. To hide the icon, right-click the Copilot icon and select “Hide Copilot”. This will open Settings to toggle the icon’s visibility. Admins can control whether the Copilot icon shows in the toolbar using the Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Performance settings update and feature name changes
items.description: Efficiency mode feature name will change to energy saver and efficiency mode for PC gaming name will be renamed PC gaming boost to better describe the feature benefits.  The new names will be in browser performance settings after the update.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Admin units support for SharePoint Online
items.description: Delegate management and remediation authority for different people in different regions or organization units with role-based access control (RBAC). For example, German investigators should be able to investigate alerts and audit events for only German users. This update extends support to SharePoint for Microsoft 365.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate icons for your agents using AI in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: A picture is worth a thousand words. Before, Microsoft 365 Copilot agent builders would need to use the default icon or manually upload their own image. This process meant browsing the web for an image, asking different teams for icons, or manually drawing one. Users can now use AI to describe how the icon should look like, thus helping inform end users of the agent's function more easily, with more expression. Users can now generate icons using AI in Agent Builder. Users can enter custom prompts or use the description of the agent to generate the icon. Alternatively, users can manually upload

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Data Loss Prevention: DLP to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing on emails with sensitivity labels
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is extended to preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing emails with sensitivity labels. This feature will allow DLP policies to provide detection of sensitivity labels in emails as enterprise grounding data and restrict access of the labeled emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat experiences.

items.title: SharePoint: eSignature - Free Text Field Support
items.description: SharePoint eSignature users would be able to add custom free text fields to their request documents. This new eSignature field can be used to request information (such as address, full name, etc.) from signers.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ camera controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: If the camera is not currently auto-framing the room, in-room users can now control the Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) of the active camera to keep the focus where they want it.

items.title: Microsoft 365: eSignature Smart Tagging for Electronically Signed Documents
items.description: Documents that have been electronically signed will now be automatically recognized and tagged as “Signed” upon upload to SharePoint. This enhancement also applies retroactively as existing e-signed files will be updated with the appropriate tags. To give users more visibility and control, we’re introducing two optional metadata columns for document libraries: Electronically Signed – Indicates whether a document has been eSigned. Signature Provider – Displays the service used for the eSignature. This feature is available exclusively to tenants with eSignature enabled, helping streamline compli

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Catchup on important emails in Copilot Chat
items.description: Copilot Chat helps you stay on top of your inbox by highlighting important and actionable emails such as messages from your manager, leadership, top collaborators, or emails containing tasks when you use prompts like “What’s hot in my inbox?” or “What were the important emails from last week?”

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Share apps from app bar via right click
items.description: Allow users to right-click and share apps directly from the app icon on hover, while using the app.

items.title: Excel: Refresh queries from Authenticated Data Sources in Excel for the Web
items.description: You can now refresh Power Query data from data sources that require authentication in Excel for the Web.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Knowledge templates support for ServiceNow Knowledge Connector
items.description: Earlier ServiceNow Knowledge connector did not support ingestion of content for articles created using templates in ServiceNow. But now ServiceNow Knowledge connector supports ingestion of knowledge articles based on out-of-the-box templates like FAQ, How to, What is, etc. & even custom templates used by the customers in their organization.

items.title: Outlook: Collapsible Automatic Replies on Outlook for iOS
items.description: Now when users receive multiple automatic replies at once, they appear collapsed in the reading pane by default. Users can then expand to see all the automatic replies if desired.

items.title: Outlook: Collapsible Automatic Replies on Outlook for Android
items.description: Now when users receive multiple automatic replies at once, they appear collapsed in the reading pane by default. Users can then expand to see all the automatic replies if desired.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New Policy Setting to Require Explicit Consent for Recording and Transcription in Teams 1:1 Calls
items.description: We're expanding the capability to require explicit consent for recording and transcription to include 1:1 calls in Microsoft Teams. A new setting in the Teams Calling policy allows admins to enforce this requirement before recording or transcription can begin. When a user with the policy initiates recording, transcription, or both in a 1:1 call, the other participant is automatically muted, with their camera and content sharing turned off. The participant will see a prompt asking whether they consent to be included in the recording and transcription.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Enhancement to Copilot studio agents report
items.description: Following further review, this feature continues in development. We apologize for any inconvenience. Enhancement to Copilot studio agents report (Preview) 1. Addition of Weekly active user count 2. Report aggregation changed to weekly to main consistency with other reports

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Silent test call
items.description: Silent Test enables IT administrators to proactively run synthetic Teams call simulations to specific subnets, helping assess network readiness and detect potential issues before they impact users, ensuring a seamless communication experience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Doc library default labeling for SharePoint Online and Copilot
items.description: This new capability further integrates SharePoint Online with Purview sensitivity labeling. SharePoint Online document library owners can set a new type of default label on the library, which automatically applies that label to all unprotected Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files within the library. This simplifies labeling in bulk across document libraries in an organization, enriches DLP and Copilot with signal to allow admins to monitor and restrict access to this content, and enables inheritance of sensitivity labels to output artifacts in Copilot. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft 365: Multi-Geo In-Region Routing
items.description: Multi-Geo In-Region Routing (IRR) enables customers to control the routing of inbound emails. Using IRR, customers can set the geo-region that inbound mail should be routed to for specific Accepted Domains.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): When using Agent Mode in Word, you will be able to manually select which model to use
items.description: Agent Mode in Word lets you choose from multiple models, giving you flexibility to select the right model for your task.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Select multiple messages to forward
items.description: You can now select up to five messages from a chat or channel and forward them together in one message—preserving both context and order.

items.title: Outlook: Sort by flag
items.description: We are adding support for sort by flag status, flag due date and flag start date.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: SharePoint agent analytics on Viva Insights
items.description: Explore how your employees used key SharePoint agent features over a given time period and understand the ROI. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Conditional Access support for Entra ID Account Recovery
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID Account Recovery is an advanced authentication recovery mechanism that enables users to regain access to their organizational accounts when they've lost access to all registered authentication methods. This feature adds additional support for protecting the account recovery flow by enabling CA policies to be applied. Learn more

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat
items.description: Available for M365 users without a M365 Copilot license. From Chat, you can use natural language to generate and direct edits to new and existing documents, when in an Edit mode. In this mode, Copilot will ask clarifying questions if needed, and after making changes will recap actions take and recommended next steps. Changes to the document are supported with controls in the document canvas to review changes made.

items.title: Exchange: Message Trace - Custom Retention
items.description: We will be introducing customizable retention options for Message Trace logs. Organizations will be able to choose from a predefined set of retention periods.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Recommended Notebooks in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Users can quickly create new Copilot Notebooks via Recommended Notebooks based on recent user work activity.

items.title: Microsoft Intune: Assignment filters support for Apple declarative device management (DDM)
items.description: Admins can use assignment filters when targeting Apple DDM policies.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit a Page using Copilot Chat on Mobile
items.description: Mobile users can now use Copilot Chat to edit Pages.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance- Alert improvements
items.description:
Communication Compliance is improving the capabilities and customization of policy alerts. Admins will be able to customize the alert frequency per policy as well as adjust the email alerts frequency and recipients within the policy creation wizard. 
Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance provides the tools to help organizations detect regulatory compliance violations (for example SEC or FINRA), such as sensitive or confidential information, harassing or threatening language, and sharing of adult content. Built with privacy by design, usernames are pseudonymized by default, role-based acce

items.title: Microsoft Intune: Recovery Lock management for macOS
items.description: This feature adds the ability to manage the password used to access the macOS recovery partition. Configuring a recovery OS password prevents users from booting company-owned devices into recovery mode, reinstalling macOS, and bypassing remote management.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention OCR Cost Estimator Support for MAC Endpoints
items.description: OCR Cost Estimator allows you to estimate the potential cost for using Optical Character Recognition. This means that you will no longer be required to set up an Azure Subscription for billing first and can accurately estimate the cost you would have incurred while using OCR. This will help you to identify the optimal configuration settings for OCR as per your requirements. Cost Estimator can be used for 30 days and will not scan images for sensitive content.

items.title: SharePoint: M365 Agent Access Insights for SharePoint and OneDrive sites
items.description: Rich insights on agents accessing content in SharePoint and OneDrive sites as part of SharePoint Advanced Management controls.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhancements to channel agents
items.description: Each channel can have a dedicated agent that draws on the channel’s knowledge to act as a domain expert for the team. New enhancements enable the agent to use files from the channel’s SharePoint when responding to queries, create ad hoc status reports configured through natural language, and generate new workback plans that can be added to Planner. In addition, new controls in Teams Admin Center allow admins to disable automatic agent creation.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: ID Account Recovery
items.description: Self-Serv Account Recovery for tenants using Passkey.Account Recovery from Total Loss using Verified ID with Face Check

items.title: Microsoft Forms: Enable Sensitivity Labels
items.description: Microsoft Forms will enable sensitivity labels, empowering organizations to control access and manage information protection directly within Forms. Authors and co-authors will be able to manually assign or edit sensitivity labels on forms, ensuring that only users with appropriate permissions can access form design and response pages. Sensitivity labels will also be inherited by Excel files generated from Forms, maintaining consistent data protection across exported content.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, and Outlook for DoD
items.description: Easily access Copilot Chat from a side pane in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, and Outlook. This is available for Copilot Chat users with a Microsoft 365 license and for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users.

items.title: SharePoint: Page Agent
items.description: The SharePoint Page Agent is a declarative agent that enables users to create and refine SharePoint pages directly within BizChat or other Copilot apps. It seamlessly integrates SharePoint authoring into everyday conversations, eliminating the need to switch apps or manually open SharePoint. With this feature, users can generate structured content such as meeting recaps, announcements, and project updates, create SharePoint pages instantly from chat.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Your Command Center for AI Success
items.description: The refreshed Copilot landing page in Microsoft 365 admin center gives an at-a-glance view of your Copilot journey across Chat, Agents, and M365 Copilot. It includes success metrics for each pillar, new metrics like active chat users, assisted hours, and satisfaction rate, plus multi-signal, personalized and actionable insights to drive adoption. We’ve added a security pivot for Purview actions and centralized Copilot usage reports under a new usage pivot.

items.title: SharePoint: Get relevant information from Lists in Knowledge Agent
items.description: Users will be able to find relevant information, matching items and get answers from Microsoft Lists using Knowledge Agent.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing integration with Data Security Posture Management and deepening integration with Defender XDR, Insider Risk Management
items.description: Data Security Investigations (DSI) insights are now being incorporated into Data Security Posture Management to support the prevention of sensitive content exfiltration. Additionally, DSI integrations with Defender XDR and Insider Risk Management are being enhanced, reflecting customer feedback received during the Public Preview phase.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified Agent Creation experience
items.description:
Drastically simplified first run experience and guide users quickly from idea to success.
Faster responses and improved performance for a smoother experience. Familiar, intuitive flow that mirrors Copilot’s simplicity.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Channel agent to 3P MCP tool orchestration in Teams channels
items.description: Agent-MCP Orchestration in Teams enables Channel agent to work with select third-party MCP servers, such as GitHub, Asana and  Atlassian (JIRA). This setup allows collaborative workflows that mirror real human teamwork. When a user asks Channel Agent a question, the agent can collaborate with other tools to gather information or complete tasks, transparently showing each step of its reasoning along the way.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Unified Agent and App Availability Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
items.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage agents and apps that work across Teams, Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot will be able to apply their changes consistently across all these surfaces. Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, app and agent availability  will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 co

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work context suggestions in Copilot Chat ContextIQ menu
items.description: Copilot Chat will suggest prompts and work context you have access to as you type in the prompt, helping you find relevant information for your conversations.

items.title: Microsoft 365: People Skills profile editing improvements
items.description:
People Skills is releasing two updates to give you more control over how others see your skills profile and ease of access for skill profile management.  With these updates, you can easily control the order in which the skills you confirm are displayed to others in your profile card. Additionally, you'll find a new deep link directly to skill profile editing from the Skills component on the profile card.
These updates will begin rollout to customers in November and are expected to be available to all People Skills customers by December.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Press and hold Win + C or Copilot key to activate voice on the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: Press and hold Win + C keys, or the dedicated Copilot key for applicable devices, and the Microsoft 365 Copilot app will activate voice. With voice, talk to Copilot like a personal assistant - interrupting and redirecting at any time to prepare for the workday, create documents, understand topics, and search for information. This shortcut to activate voice means you don't have to switch between screens to talk with Copilot. Enterprise-grade security and compliance are built in, so conversations stay private while productivity soars.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights - Skills landscape report for organizations
items.description: A Power BI report that provides an overview of the skills distribution in the organization and supports users in identifying skill gaps and making informed decisions on workforce planning, resource allocation, and skilling initiatives.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in Excel with Python for GCC High
items.description: Copilot in Excel gains powerful new insights and visualizations with Advanced Analysis. Explore your data in a natural, conversational way, while Copilot does the heavy lifting using Python, a rich programming language that supercharges what is possible in your spreadsheets.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Apply your brand kit and style to visual creations
items.description: Easily customize your visual content with built-in controls to select your preferred style, choose your visual format, whether it’s a poster, infographic, or image and with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, apply your brand kit.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Apply your brand kit and style to visual creations

Applying the theme includes setting the generated image on the Edge new tab page, and applying the image's dominant color to the browser frame. Admins can restrict access to this feature using the AIGenThemesEnabled policy.

items.description: This feature will enable Viva Glint Admins to remove survey participants from surveys. The selected survey must have a closed status, and this action will be irreversible.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
items.description: We are updating private channels to align with compliance model for all channels. After this change, compliance policies applied to the team (M365 Group) will apply to all channels in the team - across standard, private, and shared. Private channels will no longer need user level targeting of policies different from other channels, and private channel compliance messages will no longer be copied to user mailboxes, relying on a dedicated, internal mailbox per channel like shared channels. In addition, limits for private channels will be increased so each team can have more than 30 private chann

items.title: Outlook: Rule to display desktop alert
items.description: Create rules that trigger a desktop alert when specific emails arrive. This makes it easier to stay on top of important messages without missing a beat. Look for the new "Display a Desktop Alert" action when setting up or editing your rules. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] ​​[DevX] Compliance sensitivity labels for custom connectors
items.description: Compliance sensitivity labels for custom connectors.

items.title: Outlook: New Scheduling and Event Creation Experience
items.description: The Outlook and Teams calendars will receive an update to the scheduling and event creation experience. Additionally, new capabilities will be available in this new experience to help streamline and enhance scheduling using Copilot. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Offline Support for Calendar - Create, Edit and Delete Event support for GCC-M
items.description: We are adding more offline functionality in the new Outlook for Windows. You will now be able to create, edit, and delete events in your calendar when not connected to the internet. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Microsoft 365 Groups scoping in Teams DLP policy extend protection to 1:1/n chats
items.description: When scoping policies to Microsoft 365 Groups in Teams DLP policies, members of Teams standard and shared channel chats associated with the groups are currently protected by the policies. This change will automatically extend the protection to standard/shared channels chats in other Microsfot 365 Groups and 1:1/n (non-channel) chats. There is no longer a need to add users, security groups or other Microsoft 365 groups to protect these chats, except for customers that have enabled optical character recognition (OCR) in Teams chat.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Connector for DataStax Now Available
items.description: Customers can now connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to DataStax with Copilot connectors to query insights from distributed databases.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot Integrates with Adobe Experience Manager

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable Microsoft 365 Copilot Integration with SharePoint Server
items.description: Customers can now connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to SharePoint Server with Copilot connectors to query and manage enterprise documents.

items.title: Microsoft Intune: Windows Backup for organizations in Intune

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Updated Regional Benchmarks for employee feedback
items.description: Viva Glint will refresh its Country & Region external benchmark suites for 2025. items.description: Customers can connect M365 Copilot with Zendesk Tickets to triage and resolve customer issues with Copilot Connector.

items.description: Users on the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for iPad and iPhone devices will be directed to the standalone OneDrive app for file browsing and management. While users can still access their most recent files and search for OneDrive content within the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, advanced actions like folder navigation, permission settings, downloads, and deletions must be done in the OneDrive app.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: App Deployment in Teams Admin Center
items.description: We're introducing a new admin setting that replaces the Installed apps section in app setup policies, enabling more streamlined per-app deployment control.  With controls to pre-install the app for : all users, specific users and groups, or no users.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Customize the screen in Teams Town halls through ‘Manage what attendees see’ [Teams Premium]
items.description: The enhanced “Manage what attendees see” experience enables organizers to take their Town hall presentations to the next level. Organizers and presenters can apply layouts, backgrounds, theme colors, and name tags to deliver events that are polished, professional, and highly engaging. This feature is available to organizers with a Teams Premium license.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Raise hands in Town Hall
items.description: Currently in a Teams Town hall, attendees cannot raise their hands and share their microphone and camera as they can in a meeting. With this new update, town halls organized by users with Teams Premium will allow attendees to raise their hand like they would in a standard Teams meeting. The ability to raise a hand can signal to organizers and presenters, who can then bring attendees on screen to allow them to share their camera and microphone.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] ​​[DevX] Schema enrichment & validation for custom connectors for better relevance & UX

items.title: Outlook: Calendar support for copying, cutting, and pasting events and appointments

items.title: SharePoint: Document Libraries - A new forms experience for streamlined document collection
items.description: Introducing native forms within SharePoint Document Libraries to streamline document collection. Users can create custom forms directly in libraries for seamless file uploads and metadata submission. Forms can be shared as links within the organization, facilitating document collection without additional access. This integration enhances productivity by simplifying workflows and improving user experience.

items.title: Microsoft Intune: Intune Suite - Improved elevation detection
items.description: This improvement expands the types of elevation actions in Windows that EPM can detect and control elevation for.

items.title: Microsoft Intune: Intune Suite - Endpoint Privilege Management on single session Azure Virtual Desktop
items.description: With this release, you can use Endpoint Privilege Management elevation rules and policy to more easily manage standard users on Azure Virtual Desktop.

items.title: SharePoint: Optimizing Version History for lists and libraries
items.description: We're improving version history for SharePoint Lists and Document Libraries generated with grid view editing. This change improves reliability, reduces storage, and streamlines the user experience by consolidating multiple edits into one where possible. Automation rules and flows, if configured with item level edits, will also now trigger more efficiently.

items.title: Outlook: Automatic Draft Minimize
items.description: When users close a draft in progress, it automatically minimizes instead of closing completely. The minimized draft can now be quickly accessed via a button that appears in the message list.

items.title: Outlook: Immersive Search
items.description: After completing a search in Outlook, a user will see a Copilot entry point that will take them to an LLM generated summary of their search query (emails, Teams messages and documents) within their Copilot side pane. They will be able to interact further with Copilot to dig deeper into these results and take action items accordingly.

items.title: Microsoft Intune: Windows Quality Update management policies

It can create status reports, send emails, schedule meetings, co-author documents, and answer questions. Channel agent understands context from meetings, chats, and files, and uses that knowledge to help you move work forward. It’s designed to save time, reduce manual effort, and make collaboration more intelligent.

On phone devices, users currently access Copilot Chat in Outlook Mobile via a tab at the bottom of their screen (or in Apps). Outlook is introducing a new Copilot Chat overlay experience, allowing users to chat with Copilot while continuing to interact with their email, calendar, and contacts. This overlay will be context-aware—understanding what the user is viewing—so users can ask Copilot about the content on their screen. 

Users with M365 Copilot licenses will also benefit from Copilot’s ability to  draw on Microsoft 365 Graph to provide richer, more personalized responses.

items.description: Efficiently narrow down your search results by using SQL-like commands in the search bar. Users can quickly filter messages, files, or conversations with precise queries such as from:username, with:username or in:channel.

items.description: This feature release ‘Always-on diagnostics’, captures critical diagnostic data from onboarded endpoint devices running on macOS for EDLP issue reporting. items.description: On Outlook mobile we are improving the "Contacts" experience by showing additional profile information for your contacts, where applicable. Secondly, this improvement hides identical duplicate contacts.

items.description: Copilot makes it fast and easy to schedule a meeting from an email thread. When you use the Schedule with Copilot option, Copilot analyzes the email and creates a meeting invitation for you, filling in a meeting title and agenda, and adding the email thread as an attachment. The people on the email thread are included as meeting attendees, and you can quickly review the invitation, add or change info, and then send it out.

items.title: SharePoint: SharePoint agent usage statistics across all SharePoint sites
items.description: SharePoint agents' usage statistics would be aggregated across all SharePoint sites and available for the tenant admin persona.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Delete Schema Properties via Copilot Connector APIs
items.description:
We’re adding support for property deletion in custom Copilot connectors, giving admins and developers more control over schema evolution. With this feature, you can:
* Use Copilot connector APIs to delete or drop individual schema properties that are no longer needed.
* Keep your connector schema clean and up-to-date without requiring full re-ingestion.
* Reduce developer overhead and simplify maintenance workflows as your data models evolve.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Connector Metadata Enrichment for Custom Copilot Connectors
items.description:
We’re introducing new options that allow admins and developers to enrich their custom Copilot connectors and its schema properties with descriptive metadata.
With this update, you can now: * Provide richer context about the connection and its schema properties to Copilot’s LLM, enabling more accurate and relevant responses. Add alternate names, data source categories, common actions to your connector and description for schema properties. * Improve search and chat quality by helping Copilot better understand the semantics and purpose of your data.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Simplified People Resolution for Custom Copilot Connectors
items.description:
This feature enables connectors to resolve external identities—such as email addresses or user IDs from third-party data sources—to their corresponding Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) identities. By allowing flexible identity mapping, developers can:
* Simplify integration workflows without needing complex Graph API lookups.
* Reduce setup friction by avoiding strict dependency on object IDs.
* Improve search and chat relevance in Copilot by ensuring accurate people attribution across connected systems.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Schema Recommendations for Custom Connectors in M365 Admin Center
items.description:
Accelerate your custom connector development with intelligent schema guidance directly in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. This feature provides:
* Proposed schema suggestions tailored to the connector you’re building.
* Real-time recommendations to identify gaps or errors in your schema design to help improve search and chat results in Copilot.
Whether you're starting from scratch or refining an existing connector, this enhancement ensures your schema is optimized for Copilot extensibility and performance.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Full refresh of custom connectors datasource
