items.description: The Researcher agent now has easier entry points on the Word canvas —making it faster to go from idea to polished research report without breaking your flow.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Improved Backup and Restore Experience for the Authenticator App on iOS
items.description: Users of the Microsoft Authenticator app on iOS will be able to back up account names—including Microsoft work or school accounts, Microsoft personal accounts, and third-party accounts like Amazon or Google—using iCloud and iCloud Keychain. This enables secure, end-to-end encrypted backup of account names and TOTP credentials. When setting up a new iOS device, account names will automatically appear in the app, and users can sign in to complete setup.

items.title: SharePoint: Text Editor Copilot 'Refine' update
items.description: SharePoint is updating the capabilities of its text editor Copilot. Now, you can not only use copilot to rewrite your existing text but also use it to keep writing or add a grounding document. By answering the question "what do you want copilot to change", you can perform any number of refinements to your existing content.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Usability and privacy improvements for live captions and live transcript in meetings
items.description: Introducing enhancements to live captions and live transcripts in Microsoft Teams to make meetings more intuitive, accessible, and privacy-focused. Live captions are now scrollable, allowing users to review past conversation with more flexibility and over a larger surface area. Next, copying captions is disabled by default to protect sensitive information and support compliance. Additionally, the live transcript panel won’t open automatically with features that trigger transcription—like recording, giving users greater control over their layout. Lastly, If transcription is enabled, users who a

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Recent activity is part of Copilot's dynamic document snapshot in Word
items.description: Select the Activity tab within the Copilot summary at the top of a document for a summary of recent comments and changes. Choose a time window of 3 days, 1 week, or 2 weeks.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Recent activity is part of Copilot's dynamic document snapshot in Word
items.description: Select the Activity tab within the Copilot summary at the top of a document for a summary of recent comments and changes. Choose a time window of 3 days, 1 week, or 2 weeks.

items.title: Outlook: Add custom sounds for Mail Notifications, Reactions, and Calendar Reminders
items.description: In your Notification settings, you'll be able to add a custom sound for your mail notifications, mail reactions, and calendar notifications (aka reminders). #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Policy tuning analysis for priority content-only policies
items.description: Policy tuning analysis provides admins with a real-time prediction of the number of users in a tenant that could potentially match a given set of policy conditions. With this update, policy tuning analysis will support insider risk policies that are scoped for priority content. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their internal policies, governance, and organizational requirem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Optical character recognition (OCR) - Support for embedded images in files including Office files in SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: Optical character recognition (OCR) scanning enables Microsoft Purview to scan images for sensitive information. With Embedded support, OCR will scan content in DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and PDFs (scanned and hybrid containing searchable text and images). This will be in addition to support for standalone images

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Document snapshot in Word personalizes output
items.description: The document snapshot helps the user focus faster by surfacing the most important information for them based on their personal context.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Content suggestions in Word
items.description: Select the Suggestions tab within the Copilot summary at the top of a Word document for suggestions on improving the content of the document.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity labels protection policy support for Azure Storage
items.description: Label-based protection support is now possible for Azure Data Lake Gen 2 and Azure Blob storage, all within Microsoft Purview information Protection. You may already know how to protect Microsoft 365 data like documents or emails with sensitivity labels, and you will now be able to apply these labels and the related protections to these additional sources. In addition, you will have a consistent framework for your sensitive information by allowing your existing label scheme and extending it to apply within these sources.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Overview dashboard
items.description: We are introducing a new Overview dashboard to help customers understand how our product effectively protects their organization environment and digital assets. The overview dashboard focuses on showcasing the effectiveness of our tools, how customers can further amplify this effectiveness and our product’s leading position in comparison to the other non-Microsoft security solutions out there.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Presenter joins Townhalls via dial-in
items.description: Now, with a Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) code provided in the town hall share event dialog, organizers can share these codes with presenters. With these codes, presenters will join as an attendee and promoted to a presenter to join either the green room or the live session.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage supports 14 more languages
items.description: Viva Engage now supports 14 additional languages (listed below), making the platform more accessible to global users. This update allows employees to engage in their preferred language, helping improve communication across multilingual teams. Users can navigate to their settings in Viva Engage and choose their preferred language in the drop down under 'Language' settings. The new languages are - 1. Arabic 2. Vietnamese 3. Serbian (Latin) 4. Slovak 5. Croatian 6. Hebrew 7. Slovenian 8. Lithuanian 9. Estonian 10. Bulgarian 11. Latvian12. English (United Kingdom) 13. Spanish (Mexico) 14. French (

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Customize visuals and pages in embedded PowerBI reports
items.description: Analysts can now use embedded PowerBI edit tools to customize their reports to add visuals, pages and change themes, text and more, and then publish it to their organization.

items.title: SharePoint: Site attestation
items.description: Site attestation policy is the newest addition to the site lifecycle management suite. It is a one-stop solution to ensure your sites are secure and compliant by reducing the risk of unmanaged sites. This involves regular reviews by site owners or admins to check and confirm the accuracy of site information, including the site's necessity, its owners, members, permissions, and sharing settings. You can also choose to automate actions on sites that remain unattested for more than 3 months to prevent risks of content over exposure.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI assistant for admins in the Pro Management portal
items.description: IT admins can optimize their time and resources by utilizing the Pro Management Portal AI assistant. It offers comprehensive answers to questions about Teams meeting spaces and management solutions and delivers data and insights specific to inventory in the organization’s environment. This feature is available with Teams Rooms Pro and does not require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Configurable Keyboard Shortcuts
items.description: Set your own keyboard shortcuts to match your work preferences. Customize the keyboard shortcut for an action you frequently use by clicking on the ellipsis and selecting Keyboard shortcuts from the menu.

items.title: SharePoint: Support for click through rate metric in page analytics
items.description: This release will enhance SharePoint page analytics by adding click through rate metric. A new card will show the percentage of unique viewers who clicked on a link from the news post, providing insights into user engagement with the post.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management- OCR support in Insider Risk Management
items.description: With this update, Insider Risk Management will support the scanning technique of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to detect potentially risky activities that may lead to data security incidents related to images in SharePoint, Teams messages, and endpoints. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built w

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Set New Ringtones in Teams Mobile
items.description: This feature allows you to customize and select different sounds for various types of calls, helping you better manage your alerts and distinguish between different incoming communications. For users with Microsoft Teams Phone, this also includes calls for forwarded and delegated calls.

items.title: Microsoft Intune: On demand remediations - single device
items.description: Remediations are script packages that can detect and fix common support issues on a user's device before they even realize there's a problem. These remediations can help reduce support calls. On demand remediations enables admins to execute a remediation on demand and as soon as possible on a single device.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Manage GDPR requests in Engage admin center
items.description: You can now manage GDPR deletion requests directly within the Engage admin center, streamlining the process and reducing reliance on the legacy Yammer admin center. This update centralizes compliance actions in one modern interface.

items.title: Outlook: Create, Delete, Rename, and Move Folders
items.description: You will now be able to more easily create, delete, rename, and move folders on mobile. From your inbox, tap the Edit icon in the sidebar. Tap on any folder to create a subfolder, or rename, move, and delete that folder. You can also rearrange and nest your folders by dragging and dropping them.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot summary for transferred calls
items.description: When a call is forwarded/transferred to another colleague, users can prompt Copilot to automatically summarize the context, open questions, etc. for the call as a briefing for the receiving colleague. This feature ensures that the recipient is well-informed about the previous conversations related to the transferred call, enhancing their understanding and preparedness.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for summarization of very long documents
items.description: Copilot in Word can summarize documents up to about 1,500,000 words or 3,000 pages. This summary will be available on top of the document.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Barriers v2 support for all new onboarding customers
items.description:
Microsoft Purview Information Barriers v2 (IB v2) is now available for all new onboarding customers. IB v2 has enhanced architecture which enables the following new features:

Large-scale segment support: The segment limit in organizations has increased to 5,000.
Multi-segment support: Users can be assigned to up to 10 segments.
Flexible user discoverability: Organizations can now choose to allow IB-protected users to discover each other while adhering to IB communication and collaboration policies.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External group chat policy enforcements for max two orgs
items.description: Facilitate creation and maintenance of external group chats with bilateral policy enforcement where members in the chat can belong to a maximum of two tenants.  Allow tenant admins to control bilateral chat policy and apply it to users and groups.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Town hall usage reports in TAC will have all the relevant usage data related to town hall events in the tenant.
items.description: When Town hall was released, there were some columns/data related to each Town hall event that were missing in the TAC usage reports for IT Admins. Now all the relevant usage related data are added to the town hall usage reports available in the TAC portal for Admins.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Fix all spelling and grammar issues with Copilot
items.description: One-click solution to fix spelling and grammar errors in the document

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Users can view app ratings before installing apps or agents
items.description: We have improved user options for sharing a link for a Teams app or a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent in a chat. Links to apps and agents will have a new preview card with user ratings for users to consider before installing apps or agents in Teams and clear actions like Add (which installs the app or agent) and View detail. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is not required to share Copilot agent links but may be required to install and use the agent.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Private thumbnail using SharePoint links for courses
items.description: Private thumbnail using SharePoint links for courses hosted at SuccessFactors can be displayed at Viva Learning.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: App ratings will be available in the unfurled links
items.description: App ratings will appear on the unfurled links for shared apps and agents to allow users who rely on ratings to evaluate apps prior to installing.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability to Stop Copilot while it is generating a response
items.description: Copilot in Teams will now have a 'stop' button after sending a prompt. This will allow the user to stop Copilot's response either before the response has started to generate, or even after the response is generating. The user may then start a new prompt if they wish.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Presenter Chat while screensharing
items.description: Enable presenters to more easily access the meeting chat while screensharing by adding an entry point in the presenter toolbar.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Admin Copilot available in GCC
items.description: Microsoft Copilot in the Microsoft 365 admin center will soon be available in government clouds (GCC). Tenants that have at least one Microsoft 365 Copilot license will be able to access Copilot in the Microsoft 365 admin center via the Copilot button on the top right corner of the screen.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Opening Calls in a small window in Teams
items.description: Allowing users to open calls in a small window to reduce disruptions in Teams.

items.title: SharePoint: New File Format Support for Document Translation
items.description: We're expanding file format support for Content AI Document Translation in SharePoint Online. Newly added extensions include: xlf, tsv, tab, mdown, mdtext, mdtxt, mdwn, mht, mhtml, mkd, mkdn, odt, rmd. This update brings us in alignment with Azure Document Translation capabilities and unlocks new scenarios, such as .xlf support, which enables seamless translation of eLearning and localization content exported from many industry tools.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Open file links preference to extend across M365 apps
items.description: When it comes to how links to cloud-hosted Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files should open, you may prefer they open in a browser, desktop apps, or directly in Teams. Now, your Teams file open preference will extend to across Microsoft 365 apps starting with classic Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. This makes the open file experience consistent on your Windows PC/device. If you prefer, you will still be able to choose your Teams file open preference separately.

items.title: Outlook: Additional features on the profile card in Outlook Mobile
items.description: Reachability panel, hybrid location, and pronouns (read only) will be available on the Outlook profile card in iOS and Android. Events panel will be replaced with the calendar in Outlook mobile.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Button Support on Multiple Connected Peripheral Devices
items.description: You can now use the Teams button across peripheral devices without having to manually select a specific device in the Teams devices settings. This ensures a more seamless experience navigating across multiple certified for Microsoft Teams personal peripheral USB devices (with a wire or a dongle) connected to the same host device (such as your laptop). For example, you can use the Teams button on headset A to bring up the meeting pre-join screen, then use the Teams button on headset B to join the meeting, and then use the Teams button on your connected speakerphone to raise hand in the meeting,

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard Trendline Additions
items.description: Copilot Dashboard users can now visualize trends in additional key adoption and impact metrics over time to more quickly identify patterns and opportunities in employee adoption for better licensing decisions. Users will be able to now view Adoption metrics on either a monthly or weekly timeframe for specific groups of interest, as well as deep dive into Impact metrics like Copilot Assisted Hours, Actions Taken, and feature-specific dimensions.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in Teams meetings responses can be exported to Word and Excel
items.description: Now, certain responses from Copilot in Teams meetings will have an option to ‘edit in’ Word or Excel. The ‘edit in’ option for Word will be available for Copilot responses that are long (more than 1300 characters) and will automatically open a Word document with the response written. The ‘edit in’ option for Excel will be available for Copilot responses that are formatted in a table, and will automatically open an Excel file with the formatted response added. Copilot responses can only be exported if the meeting policy for the meeting is set to allow copying or forwarding of meeting chat, live

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Current web content included when drafting with Copilot in Word
items.description: Draft with Copilot will include information from Bing search, resulting in content that's as current as what you would find when searching with Bing on the web.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Search Skill (Copilot in Engage)
items.description: Engage Copilot now uses search skills to find and summarize relevant posts, with citations and direct links.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Catchup Skill (Copilot in Engage)
items.description: Catch up effortlessly on Home Feed or Community conversations since you last checked- this card will provide a personalized update to what you missed since you last logged into the Viva Engage homepage or since you last clicked into the Feed for a specific Community you follow

items.title: Planner: New Microsoft Planner App for Teams for customers in GCC-H
items.description: The new Microsoft Planner app in Teams is a single, unified work management experience. It brings together the simplicity of To Do, the collaboration of Planner and the power of Project into a single and simple solution that offers individual task management, collaborative work management as well as enterprise work management.

items.title: Outlook: Prioritize my inbox by Copilot
items.description: Prioritize my inbox by Copilot marks high priority mails in your inbox and provides a short summary of the mail's importance in the message list and the reading pane. Mails can be sorted and filtered by Copilot's priority. In Web and New Outlook for Windows, you can also choose to have Copilot mark low priority mails. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Drafting on a selection includes being able to reference files, emails, and meetings
items.description: Just like when you're using Copilot to draft content on a blank line in your document, you can reference resources that provide context in addition to the content you've selected in your document.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Ability to rename the policy and rule names in DLP
items.description: This feature gives the ability for the DLP admin to rename the existing policy/rule without having to create the entire the rule or policy again.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Copilot Pages on your mobile phone
items.description: Create Copilot Pages from Copilot Chat on your mobile phone to continue working on the go.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Copilot Prompt Gallery - Share a prompt to a Microsoft Teams team
items.description: Share custom prompts with members of a Microsoft Teams team from the Copilot Prompt Gallery App, allowing team members to easily discover and utilize these prompts in Copilot Prompt Gallery App.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage - Leaders updated via group sync
items.description: Currently, leaders are managed in Viva Engage manually. If you wish to add or remove leaders, you need to go to Engage to do so. This feature will allow you to define a group that includes users who should be designated as leaders. As you add or remove people from that group, they will gain or lose privileges accordingly. The manual method will continue to be available.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Progressive alert scoring
items.description:
With this new
feature, user activities that could potentially result in data security
incidents will be assessed more frequently within a 24-hour period compared
with the current practice of once every 24 hours. Alert insights will now be
updated every few hours with this increased frequency, providing designated
analysts with timely alerts and continuously evolving insights. Microsoft

potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data
leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables c

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Additional actions include submit, allow/block, and trigger AIR from Advanced Hunting.
items.description: SoC  will be able to do submissions and tenant level block and trigger investigation actions from Advanced Hunting

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Catch up on a summary of document comments in the top of your document
items.description: Copilot will have a Discussion tab in the top of your document to summarize open comments, helping you quickly understand what people have said in comments.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot surfaces key statistics in the top of a document
items.description: Copilot includes a summary at the top of key statistics from your Word document.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Catch up on a summary of document comments in the top of your document
items.description: Copilot will have a Discussion tab in the top of your document to summarize open comments, helping you quickly understand what people have said in comments.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Drafting on a selection includes being able to reference files, people, emails, and meetings
items.description: Just like when you're using Copilot to draft content on a blank line in your document, you can reference resources that provide context in addition to the content you've selected in your document.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Drafting on a selection includes being able to reference files, people, emails, and meetings
items.description: Just like when you're using Copilot to draft content on a blank line in your document, you can reference resources that provide context in addition to the content you've selected in your document.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference People from your enterprise in Copilot in Word
items.description: Users can now reference People from your enterprise while generating content in Word.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Together Mode New Flow
items.description:
After further review, this feature continues rolling out. We apologize for any inconvenience.
Together mode will get a new simplified flow which will take the user from the beginning to the end through the steps of setting up the scene, assigning the seats and applying for everyone in the call in a transparent and easy-to-understand way. The function itself does not change but there will be more transparency thanks to the icons on the meeting toolbar for an easy access for each next step in the familiar Together mode flow.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Customize the location of Teams notifications on web
items.description: You can now customize where your Teams notification appear on your screen when using Teams on web. Options include bottom right, top right, bottom left, and top left, allowing you to choose the most convenient and least intrusive location for a better experience and productivity.

items.title: SharePoint: SharePoint agents in Teams Mobile
items.description: Use SharePoint agents in Teams Mobile group chats and meetings.

items.title: SharePoint: Design ideas for quick links webpart
items.description: Design Ideas now provides formatting suggestions for the quick links webpart. This includes suggesting icons and images for a given link, as well as showing how the webpart would look with different card sizes, for single quick link webparts in a section.

items.title: SharePoint: Design Ideas for Blank Flexible Sections
items.description: When you add a blank flexible section to your page, you will now be able to open up the Design Ideas panel to get blank section suggestions just as you can for standard sections.

items.title: SharePoint: Design Ideas Suggests Images from Org Assets
items.description: SharePoint Design ideas can now pull from your Org Asset images to use within design ideas. If available when performing image suggestion, the first 3 ideas will show suggestions with images from org assets, whereas the rest of the ideas will use stock images.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Amplify - Animated GIFs in email
items.description: We are bringing animated GIFs to email crafted by Viva Amplify.  GIFs of limited size will appear as animations in Outlook clients.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot takes emails and meetings into account while drafting content in Word
items.description: You will no longer need to reference certain types of organizational data for Copilot to generate contextually relevant content. People and chats will still need to be referenced explicitly.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create the perfect banner for your document with Copilot and Designer
items.description: Chat with Copilot in Word, and let Designer help your document stand out by producing eye-catching visuals that fill the width of the page.

items.title: OneDrive: Annotate with Apple Pencil Experience on OneDrive for iOS
items.description: Annotating with hand-drawn content in the OneDrive apps for iOS and iPadOS is now easier than ever. Enjoy various types of annotation tools and expressive strokes that match your pressure.

items.title: Windows 365: Available from New Zealand North
items.description: Windows 365 will be available in New Zealand North.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Forward messages with app cards
items.description: Messages containing app cards in chats and channels can now be forwarded. To use, navigate to the more actions menu of any message containing an app card, and select "Forward".

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Developers building agents in Azure AI Foundry can ground their agent in files stored in SharePoint
items.description: Tenant Graph grounding provides grounding for agents with relevant information from Microsoft Graph, including files stored in SharePoint. This capability is now available to developers building agents in Azure AI Foundry.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Inline preview of files shared
items.description: Now you can review a file shared in chat and channels in your flow of work. Select ‘preview’ and scroll through the file’s content without leaving the chat or channel.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Advanced moderation access control for corporate communicators
items.description: Network admins can choose to enable advanced moderation access for corporate communicators to manage AI themes + keywords detected within organization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - New ChatGPT Enterprise connector to discover and bring prompts and responses into the scope of Purview features
items.description: Using the unified Purview portal, organizations will be able to establish a connection to their ChatGPT Enterprise workspaces to discover, collect, and store contents of interactions of users with ChatGPT Enterprise into the scope of Purview capabilities and policies.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Editor simplification and introduction of light mode
items.description: This change will simplify the Clipchamp editing experience and increase the space you have on the stage to make great videos. We're also introducing light mode as a new option for people to choose whether they view the Clipchamp editor in a Light or Dark scheme.

items.title: Planner: Smart backgrounds for basic plans
items.description: Get ready to customize your plans like never before! With smart backgrounds, you’ll be able to quickly spot the right plans. This feature was part of our legacy Planner experience, and we’re now enabling it for basic plans in the new Planner.

items.title: Whiteboard: Existing Azure Board Migration
items.description: This feature will migrate boards that exist in your tenant's Azure storage to OneDrive for Business storage. More information will follow as we near release.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot extensibility – Developers can build custom engine agents with the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK
items.description: Developers can use the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK to create custom engine agents. These agents, built on their own AI stack, can be deployed to various platforms, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Teams, and other non-Microsoft channels.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Updated settings for the Microsoft 365 app on Windows
items.description: The Microsoft 365 app on Windows added settings to pin the app to the taskbar.

items.title: Windows 365: Concurrency assignment for Windows 365 Frontline in dedicated mode
items.description: Concurrency assignment in Windows 365 Frontline in dedicated mode refers to the number of active Cloud PCs that can be used simultaneously within the total number of licensed Cloud PC usage for Frontline. This allocation ensures that resources are optimized based on the specific needs of the organization and its users.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New Feature access management UI in Admin Center
items.description: Through the new Feature Access management user interface, admins will be able to manage feature access settings directly in Microsoft 365 admin center. Feature access management allows admins to use access policies to manage which users can access specific features in Viva apps, so you can tailor your deployments to meet your local regulatory or business requirements. Previously, these policies could only be managed with Microsoft PowerShell cmdlets. After this rollout, admins can choose to use either Microsoft 365 admin center or PowerShell to manage feature access. Existing policies set for

items.title: SharePoint: Modifications in the Embedded container type creation cmdlets in PowerShell
items.description: We’re introducing modifications in the container type creation cmdlets. The New-SPOContainerType cmdlet will only create a new container type. We are introducing the Add-SPOContainerTypeBilling cmdlet to add billing profile to the new container type.

items.title: SharePoint: Additional support on SPAC to identify different types of Embedded containers and their principal owner
items.description: The update enables SharePoint Embedded Administrators (SPE Admins) to identify the different kind of containers (user, tenant, and group) and the principal owner associated with the container.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Updates to the Microsoft 365 app
items.description: The Microsoft 365 app name, icon, and UI will evolve to support future AI-first experiences. Key UI changes include reducing the top header and consolidating app-level tools and settings into the App toolbar on the left.

items.title: Word: Draft on a selection and retain your existing formatting
items.description: Draft on a selection and retain your existing formatting so that your content is seamless and fits with your document.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated welcome screen for the Microsoft 365 app on Windows
items.description: The Microsoft 365 app welcome screen on Windows will be updated to display a welcome message and progress bar while the Microsoft 365 app loads.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: List-based Forms card for Viva Connections Dashboard
items.description: This feature will allow operators to add a card for any form/survey created for data collection on the Viva Connections Dashboard for attention and quick action.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Unified Google Workspace Migration
items.description: Offer Microsoft 365 customers a seamless experience for migrating Google Workspace workloads to M365. Through a unified portal page, you can initiate and monitor migration tasks for both Gmail and Google Drive. Additionally, if your Google Workspace tenant has fewer than 1,000 users, you'll benefit from the newly revamped Gmail migration flow, which simplifies the process and guides you through each step.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Google Groups to M365 Modern Groups Migration Service
items.description: Google Groups to M365 Modern Groups Migration Service is a 1st party service for migrating Google groups with the M365 Admin center as a new feature, so that Google compete customers moving to M365 would have the ability to automatically create the groups, its members, member conversations and all permissions to M365 Groups without the need to recreate the groups which is the only solution for customers moving from Google.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Google to Entra Identity Sync service
items.description: Google to Entra Identity Sync service is a cloud-2-cloud user Identity onboarding and one way synchronization tool from Google workspace to Entra ID. This will be available as part of the M365 Admin center for Google compete customers moving into M365 to create the identities in M365 farm and move Drive and Mail content into Onedrive and Exchange online

items.title: OneDrive: Convert Copilot response into a Word file
items.description: Like a summary or FAQ that Copilot generated for you? Now, with one click, you can convert any Copilot response into a Word document. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to commercial customers on OneDrive Web.

items.title: OneDrive: Create a presentation from a Word file
items.description: With Copilot, you can create the first draft of your presentation using a Word file in just a single click. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to commercial customers on OneDrive Web.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: EDU tenant type selection in policy wizard
items.description: Admins can now select tenant type for their institution from the policy wizard. This setting can be changed anytime from the wizard.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Dedicated Backup Administrator Role for Microsoft 365 Backup
items.description: Use a dedicated Backup Administrator role to manage your M365 Backup administration tasks.

items.title: Microsoft Stream: Video reactions
items.description: This feature will allow users to add or remove reactions to specific points of a recorded video via Stream Web App and Embed. Viewers will be able to see how their colleagues feel about a video and show their support towards the video owner. These reactions will be present in the timeline to highlight the most important parts of the video and can be used for navigation. Also, owners of the video can see detailed analytics about when viewers are reacting to videos and have ability to disable the feature.  This feature was incorrectly updated to a status of rolling out upon preview availability.

items.title: Microsoft Stream: Seek bar thumbnails for Teams meeting recordings
items.description: This feature adds seek bar (preview) thumbnails to Microsoft Stream's video player. The thumbnails provide a preview of the video content when hovering over the player's seek bar at a certain timestamp. Currently, it will only be made available for Teams meeting recordings.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity labels protection policy support for Microsoft Fabric
items.description: Your organization can now apply sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview Information Protection to Microsoft Fabric workspaces. This new functionality will allow users to manually label Fabric items with their sensitivity level and then apply access control protections based upon the protection policies set by administrators.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage - Topic Subscription notification
items.description: This feature allows users to subscribe to notifications for Viva Engage topics they follow. Users will receive a Viva Engage bell notification when a new post is tagged with a topic they are subscribed to or when the topic is added to an existing post.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Latest meeting experiences with performance improvements on web for Safari and Firefox (for anonymous join only)
items.description: The latest Teams meeting experiences will be available for Teams on the web in Safari and Firefox browsers - including performance improvements, refreshed pre-join, updated meeting stage, and the updated meeting toolbar. (for anonymous join only)

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Passkey authentication in brokered Microsoft apps on Android
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID users can now use a passkey to sign into Microsoft apps on Android devices where an authentication broker like Microsoft Authenticator or Microsoft Intune Company Portal is installed.

items.title: OneDrive: Admins can configure a group policy to block specific folders from OneDrive Sync
items.description: In addition to being able to configure a group policy to exclude specific files or file extensions from Syncing with OneDrive, admins can now exclude folders as well. End-users will be able to see the excluded folders in the Sync configuration applied to them via their OneDrive Advanced Settings.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: False positive email release from Quarantine through threat explorer, email summary panel, advanced hunting, and custom detection email entity page take action
items.description: SecOps can now mange False positives and take move to inbox (i.e. release) quarantined messages from Threat explorer, advanced hunting, custom detection and Email entity page without the need to tab out to the Quarantine portal to take the action.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: School Connection –  Providing access to parents via their phone number
items.description: The School Connection app in Microsoft Teams (mobile) empowers parents and guardians to engage, support, and monitor their student's learning at school. This release enables a parent/guardian to get access to their child’s profile in School Connection if they login to Teams (mobile) with their phone number and the school has registered that phone number as a parent/guardian contact. Additionally, a parent/guardian will easily get access to their child’s profile if the phone number or email address that is registered by the school is saved as a login information in their Microsoft account. items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot assisted goal authoring with Context IQ grounding
items.description: When generating goals, users will be able to add more than one file from context IQ suggestions as references in their prompts to Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft 365 admin centers –  Manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and Microsoft 365 App
items.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App will be able to apply their changes across all three clients (Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App). Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, management of these apps will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Change background while recording on phone
items.description: You can record a video clip with your phone camera and switch your background to any picture you want or make it blurry. With this feature, you can record yourself anywhere and share it with coworkers in your Teams chat or channel.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Search in Viva Connections on iOS and Android tablet
items.description: This adds a search entry point and a new tailored experience for Viva Connection users on iOS and Android tablets.
